공식 게임 번역을 바탕으로 오퍼레이터·맹약·증강·패치노트의 다국어 표시를: Expanded translations for Operators, Alliances, augments, and patch notes using official game translations.
모바일 상단바를 한 줄로 정리하고 설정의 언어 선택기 배치를 통일했습니다: Kept the mobile top bar on one row and aligned the language selector with other settings.
증강 모드의 보스 HP를 등장한 증강 등급에 따라 누적 적용합니다. 기본: Augment mode boss HP scales cumulatively with the grades offered. Starting at 100%, multiply by 1.3 for Silver, 1.5 for Gold, and 1.7 for Prismatic.
적 증강의 회복·상태 이상·원소 피해·이동 속도·방어력 감소 수치를 조정: Rebalanced enemy augment regeneration, status duration, Elemental damage, Movement Speed, and DEF reduction. Replaced RES reduction with Arts damage increase. Damage over time is 40/70/100 per second.
돌파 증강은 일반 전투와 협력방어에서 적이 방어 포인트에 진입할 때마다: Breakthrough immediately deducts 1 HP each time an enemy enters a Defense Point in normal battles and Unite Phase.
첸 더 던스트릭 3스킬의 체력 비례 피해가 30만을 초과하면 해당 검기: Ch’en the Dawnstreak’s Skill 3 sword-wave hit is void if its HP-based damage exceeds 300,000, regardless of the custom damage ceiling.
살카즈 대검사의 연속 공격 모션과 웨이브 캐스터의 주 대상 공격 이펙트: Improved consecutive attack animations for Sarkaz Greatswordsmen and primary-target attack visuals for Wave Casters.
Added Battlefield #01 to optional custom maps for Hard, Extreme, and Transcendent simulations.
라이타니엔·우르수스의 인게임 맹약 설명과 증강 효과 설명의 강조 표기를: Standardized emphasis in in-game Leithanien/Ursus Alliance descriptions and augment effect descriptions.
게임 모드 및 공개 방 추가: Added game modes and public rooms
클래식·증강·커스텀 모드를 추가하고 전투 기록에 선택한 모드를 표시합니다: Adds classic, augmented, and custom modes and displays the selected mode in the battle record. The default mode for new rooms is Custom.
클래식은 커스텀 설정을 적용하지 않습니다. 증강은 증강 기능과 고정된 적: Classic does not apply custom settings. Augments apply Augment features and fixed enemy Augment rules. Even if you change modes, saved custom settings will be preserved.
증강 모드의 일반 적은 HP 140%, 공격력·방어력 120%, 마법 저: Normal enemies in augmented mode have 140% HP, 120% attack/defense, and 150% magic resistance, while bosses have 400% HP, 120% attack/defense, and 150% magic resistance.
The basic grade weight of Augment has been changed to Silver, Gold, and Prism 2/5/3.
로비에 공개 방 목록을 추가했습니다. 모드·인원·난이도 필터, 진행 중인: Added public room list to lobby. It supports mode, number of people, and difficulty filters, room display in progress, participation, and spectating, and is updated every 10 seconds.
연합 방은 클래식·증강 모드에서 방장이 공개로 전환할 수 있습니다. 공개: Alliance rooms can be switched to public by the room leader in classic or augmented mode. Once public, you cannot revert to private or select custom mode.
커스텀 설정의 설명을 바로 확인할 수 있도록 변경하고 일반 적 스펙 조정: We changed the description of custom settings so that you can see them right away, and separated general enemy spec adjustments into a separate tab.
판매·퇴각 단축키가 마우스가 가리키는 오퍼레이터 대신 겹쳐 보이는 다른: Fixed an issue where the sell/retreat shortcuts were applied to other overlapping operators instead of the operator the mouse was pointing at.
선발·커스텀 설정 및 전투 통계 개선: Improved selection/custom settings and battle statistics
커스텀 설정·전투 통계의 구성을 개선하고 상단 메뉴의 크기와 정렬을 통일: We have improved the configuration of custom settings and battle statistics, and unified the size and alignment of the top menu.
공통 적용 전략을 초상화 목록으로 변경했습니다. 프리셋 작업 버튼 너비를: Changed common application strategy to portrait list. The width of the preset operation buttons has been unified, and saving, loading, and deleting custom presets have been placed in one line.
대기실 초대코드, 난이도·리롤 선택 영역을 정렬하고 채팅 제목을 진영 선: The waiting room invitation code, difficulty/reroll selection areas have been aligned, and the chat title has been moved to the same line as the faction selection button. The instructions for rooms where spectating is not allowed have been changed to clarify.
핑 표시를 기존 스타일로 복원하고 대기실 원본 버튼과 설정 플러그인 탭을: Restored ping display to old style and removed original lobby button and Settings plugin tab.
Changed to share skill, module, and skin settings for 5th and 6th level selection.
선발한 오퍼레이터를 단계별 색상의 2×2 칸에 표시하고 스킬·모듈·해제: Selected operators were displayed in 2×2 squares colored by each stage, and the positions of the skill, module, and release buttons were fixed. The blank space opens a portrait selection window with a search bar.
선발 여부에 따라 원래 오퍼레이터 목록 순서가 바뀌지 않도록 변경했습니다: Changed the original operator list order to not change based on selection.
전투 통계와 실시간 통계에 간소·상세 보기를 추가했습니다. 저장 통계는: Simplified and detailed views have been added to battle statistics and real-time statistics. Saved statistics support merged views such as operator, job group, stage, type, and player, as well as bar, ratio, trend, and table graphs.
Improved statistical summary, image size, mobile screen, and scroll area.
The issued equipment for Victoria Equipment Support III has been modified to include Heart of Steam.
적 증강 투표가 끝나면 결과를 먼저 표시하고 3초 카운트다운 후 적용하도: When the enemy Augment vote is over, the results are displayed first and applied after a 3-second countdown.
신병·헤드헌팅 등 증강 아이콘이 비율을 유지하면서 정해진 영역 안에 들어: Augment icons such as recruits and headhunting have been modified to fit within a defined area while maintaining the proportions.
Touch 전략의 중복 적용 설명과 색상 태그가 있는 설명에 남은 중국어: The remaining Chinese in the overlapping application description of the Touch strategy and the description with color tags has been corrected to Korean.
S.W.E.E.P. 리포트 · 전투 이펙트 및 화면 수정: S.W.E.E.P. Report · Battle effects and screen modifications
로비에 원본 전용 아이콘을 사용한 S.W.E.E.P. 리포트를 추가하고,: S.W.E.E.P. using the original exclusive icon in the lobby. Added a report and changed access to statistics from the nickname box.
맹약·전략·적 자료와 전체 증강 목록을 제공하며 우르수스·라이타니엔 정보: It provides Alliance, strategy, enemy data and a complete list of Augments, and includes information on Ursus and Laitanien. Selections are excluded from the list of operators by Alliance.
증강 보고는 검색을 지원하고 등급에 맞는 색상과 작은 항목 크기를 적용했: Augmented reporting supports search and applies grade-appropriate colors and smaller item sizes. The 35 augmented icon series have been changed to the original symbols that match their names and effects.
우르수스·라이타니엔 설명을 기존 맹약 형식으로 정리하고 3명 배치 문구를: The descriptions of Ursus and Laitanien have been organized into the existing Alliance format, and the text for placing 3 people has been removed. Grace and sheet music were excluded from related equipment.
URL에 대괄호가 포함된 맵 텍스처를 로컬 미리보기에서 불러오지 못해 방: Fixed an issue where map textures with square brackets in the URL could not be loaded in the local preview, resulting in defense/invasion points disappearing.
레온하르트 등 즉시 시전 스킬의 공식 이펙트를 타격 시점에 연결하고, 무: The official effects of instant-cast skills such as Leonhard have been tied to the point of impact, and the 0 mark on damage blocked due to invincibility has been removed.
바닥 범위 이펙트를 전장 기준 높이로 정렬하고 아로마 공격 이펙트의 시작: The floor range effect has been aligned to the height of the battlefield and the starting position of the aroma attack effect has been modified.
Restored the layout of the carousel screen to its previous format.
결과창의 문구 겹침과 버튼 표시를 정리하고 채팅·칭찬 기능을 연결했습니다: Overlapping phrases and button displays in the results window have been cleaned up, and chat and compliment functions have been connected.
결과창 표시 및 조작 · 오퍼레이터 밴 목록 수정: Display and manipulate result window · Modify operator ban list
실제 게임 진입 경로에서 결과창 전용 스타일을 불러오지 않아 화면이 비거: We fixed an issue where the screen was blank or could not be operated because the result window-specific style was not loaded in the actual game entry path.
Restored missing style connections for battle transitions and boss guides.
The untranslated text in the new results window has been corrected to Korean.
8인 결과 화면의 참가자 카드를 두 줄로 배치해 화면 밖으로 벗어나지 않: The participant cards on the 8-player results screen were placed in two rows to prevent them from going off the screen.
Removed starting operator from ban list.
오퍼레이터 설정과 같은 초상화 격자로 정리하고 등급순 정렬, 이름 검색,: We've organized it into a portrait grid like the Operator settings, sorted by rank, searched by name, and checked bans.
원본 v0.3.1 통합 · 커스텀 설정 및 전투 이펙트 수정: Original v0.3.1 integration · Modify custom settings and battle effects
야수의 심장의 정예화 오퍼레이터 지급 수를 10명에서 12명으로 변경했습: The number of elite operators in Heart of the Beast has been changed from 10 to 12.
무사 I/II/III의 공격 시 HP 회복량을 40/70/100으로 변경: Changed HP recovery amount when attacking for Warrior I/II/III to 40/70/100.
일반·보스 라운드 전투 시간을 초 단위로 설정하고 보스전을 2배속으로 진: You can set the normal/boss round battle time in seconds and proceed with the boss battle at double speed.
공통 전략 적용 및 중복 선택 시 누락되던 효과와 의태의 오퍼레이터 선택: Fixed the operator selection of effects and mimicry that were missing when applying a common strategy and making duplicate selections.
반복 공격의 공식 이펙트를 공격 준비 시점과 동기화하고, 리소스 준비가: The official effect of repeated attacks has been modified to synchronize with the attack preparation time, and to reflect the last battle time when resource preparation is delayed.
데겐블레허 3스킬의 과도한 참격 크기를 보정하고 바닥 범위 표시는 원래: Corrects the excessive slash size of Degenblecher's 3rd skill, and the bottom range display maintains its original size.
제국 드론의 조준 대상 추적 및 범위 표시와 적의 체력 조건 이펙트 위치: Fixed Imperial Drone target tracking and range display and enemy health effect location.
Operators without official effects have been supplemented to use simple effects.
공동 선택 창의 참가자 목록과 스타일 불일치로 선택 카드가 눌려 보이던: Fixed an issue where the selection card would appear squashed due to a style mismatch with the participant list in the carousel window.
원본 v0.3.1의 오퍼레이터·특질·렌더링 개선을 기존 커스텀 기능과 대: Operator, trait, and rendering improvements from the original v0.3.1 were selected and integrated against existing custom features.
폰트 다운로드의 불필요한 404 요청과 마우스 대상 단축키 처리를 수정했: Fixed unnecessary 404 requests and mouse target shortcut handling for font downloads.
통계 이미지 크기 · 맹약 밴 상태의 전략 보상 수정: Stats Image size/Alliance ban status strategy compensation modifications
전투 화면을 거치지 않고 통계·결과를 열었을 때 전략 이미지, 오퍼레이터: Fixed an issue where strategy images, operator portraits, player images, and HP icons were displayed at their original size when opening statistics/results without going through the battle screen.
공통 이미지 스타일을 항상 불러오도록 분리해 기존 표시 크기를 유지합니다: Separate common image styles to always load, preserving existing display sizes.
파가니니가 라테라노 밴 상태에서도 남아 있는 지급 가능 오퍼레이터 중에서: Paganini has been modified to now pay a cumulative 55 fund consumption reward among remaining payable operators even when the Laterano is banned.
해럴드의 주기적 오퍼레이터 지급과 페페의 상점 보장도 맹약 밴 상태에서: Harold's periodic operator payment and Pepe's store guarantee have also been modified to allow the use of remaining candidates while in a Alliance ban state.
연습실 추가 · 중첩 통계 및 배포 안정성 개선: Added practice room · Improved overlapping statistics and distribution stability
실험실 옆에 연습실을 추가했습니다. 전장·시작 라운드·인원 기준·일반 및: A practice room has been added next to the laboratory. You can choose the battlefield, starting round, number of people, normal and hidden boss, strategy, enemy special training, and Alliance ban.
연습실은 무제한 자금과 일반 상점으로 선택한 라운드부터 진행합니다. 일반: The practice room begins with the round of your choice with unlimited funds and a general store. You can use the acquisition and economic effects of the regular game, and the remaining funds information will not be displayed.
연습 중 표시를 나가기 버튼 아래 별도 행에 표시하고, 게임 기록을 연습: In-practice indicators are displayed in a separate row below the exit button, and game records are separated by practice room and excluded from general statistics.
The practice room provides statistics on the amount of stacks earned by operator and real-time graphs. The amount earned while resting is also added to that round, and while resting, you can switch between the previous round record and the current round.
시뮬레이션 표기를 핑·관전자 수 아래로 옮기고, 연합 시뮬레이션의 인원: The simulation notation has been moved below the number of pings and spectators, and the number of people selected and allowed spectators settings for the joint simulation have been placed on the same line.
자동 유지 관리와 배포가 겹칠 때 이전 버전이 다시 최신으로 지정될 수: Fixed an issue where older versions could become current again when automatic maintenance and deployments overlapped.
자동 배포 전에 배포 스크립트를 먼저 갱신합니다. 스크립트 갱신은 라우터: Update the deployment script first before automatic deployment. Script update does not restart the router and game servers.
뒤늦게 로딩된 원본 장면이 기존 커스텀 맵 셰이더를 덮어쓰지 않도록 수정: Fixed late-loading original scenes to not overwrite existing custom map shaders. Retains existing map representations, such as sand.
정적 장면의 모래 혼합 처리로 바닥 타일 무늬가 단색에 가려지던 문제를: Fixed an issue where sand blending in static scenes would cause floor tile patterns to be obscured by solid colors.
터치를 지원하는 PC에서 기기를 가로로 돌리라는 안내가 표시될 수 있던: We fixed an issue where you might be prompted to turn your device to landscape on PCs that support touch.
맵 품질 최하·경량 2D에서도 공식 전투 이펙트가 별도 설정을 따르도록: The official battle effects have been modified to follow separate settings even on the lowest/lightest 2D map quality. Retains the existing behavior of effect quality options.
공식 이펙트·맵 표현 및 접속 안정성 개선: Improved official effect/map expression and connection stability
루프 슈터 투사체의 귀환 표현을 복구하고, 제국 드론 폭격이 실제 발사·: Restored loop shooter projectile homing representation and modified Imperial Drone Strike to follow actual launch/impact timing and attack speed.
공식 이펙트 사용 시 미스틱 캐스터의 저장 공격 표시와 제국 드론의 커스: Hides the Mystic Caster's saved attack indicator and the Imperial Drone's custom attack range indicator when using the official effect.
휴식 기간에 카넬리안 등의 전투용 공식 이펙트가 생성되거나 남는 문제를: Fixed an issue where official combat effects such as Carnelian were created or remained during rest periods.
적 사망 후 오염·독구름 및 전차 오염 장판에 대응하는 공식 이펙트를 연: We have linked the official effects that respond to pollution/poison clouds and tank pollution after an enemy dies.
SP recovery and Alliance stack increase number sizes have been unified with the recovery display.
Boss damage 10% information is only displayed in 8-player mode.
사막 바닥의 모래 혼합 등 기존 맵 셰이더와 늪지대·분노 장판 표현을 복: Restored existing map shaders, including sand mixing on the desert floor, as well as swamp and fury floor expressions. I kept the current color tone and increased the contrast slightly.
Ping and number of spectators are arranged horizontally.
The top title was fixed to the center and the game method buttons were organized into icons. The Add to Home Screen button has been removed from the top.
The resource redownload button has been moved to the bottom of the settings window.
관전 허용 설정을 연합 시뮬레이션 선택 상자 우측 하단으로 옮기고, 관전: The spectating permission setting was moved to the bottom right of the alliance simulation selection box, and the spectating capacity was fixed to 8 people.
공식 이펙트와 개별 음성 다운로드 안내에서 해당 리소스만 받도록 수정했습: The official effect and individual voice download instructions have been modified to only receive the corresponding resources. The options for initial and full downloads are maintained.
설정에서 미보유 한국어·일본어 음성을 선택하면 해당 음성 다운로드를 안내: If you select a Korean or Japanese voice that you do not own in the settings, you will be guided to download the voice.
클라이언트 연결 종료와 프록시 응답이 겹칠 때 라우터가 종료될 수 있던: Fixed an issue where the router could terminate when a client connection termination and proxy response overlapped.
원본 0.3.0 병합 · 전투 및 리소스 로딩 개선: Merge of original 0.3.0 Improved combat and resource loading
원본 v0.3.0의 전투·AI·장면 렌더링 개선과 플러그인 기능을 병합했: Combat, AI, and scene rendering improvements and plug-in functions from the original v0.3.0 have been merged.
분리된 전투 모듈에서 누락된 기존 오퍼레이터·적 효과를 복구하고 한국어: Restored existing operator and enemy effects missing from separate combat modules and supplemented Korean language display.
전투 시작 후 오퍼레이터와 적이 사라지던 문제 및 전투 결과 제출이 지연: Fixed an issue where operators and enemies would disappear after the start of a battle and an issue where submission of battle results would be delayed.
Viviana's per-round trait activation limit has been restored.
설정 화면에서 돌아가기 시 빈 화면이 남던 문제와 설정 테마를 수정했습니: Fixed an issue where a blank screen remained when returning from the settings screen and the settings theme.
Added camera zoom setting when placed. The default is on.
8인 연합방어의 침입 포인트 표시와 관전 중 대기석 공격 범위 표시를 수: The display of intrusion points in the 8-person combined defense and the attack range display in the waiting area while spectating have been modified.
고정형 보스의 렌더링 순서와 사망 후 재표시 문제를 수정하고, 실험실·허: Fixed issues with fixed boss rendering order and re-display after death, and adjusted the size of Laboratory/Scarecrow Mode Jesselton to 2.5x.
기존 물 표현을 복구했습니다. 오퍼레이터별 한국어·일본어 음성 선택과 미: Restored existing water representation. Modified Korean and Japanese voice selection and preview for each operator.
메인 화면을 먼저 표시하고 리소스를 백그라운드에서 준비하도록 개선했습니다: Improved displaying the main screen first and preparing resources in the background. Readiness is indicated by a thin progress bar at the bottom of the screen.
리소스 다운로드에서 한국어·일본어 음성과 간소·공식 이펙트를 선택할 수: You can select Korean and Japanese voices and simple and formal effects from the resource download. Official effects will be downloaded when selected, and instructions will be displayed if you select full settings without having them.
다운로드 안내 테마와 접기 UI를 정리하고, 새로고침 후 이어받기·대규모: We have cleaned up the download guide theme and folding UI, and fixed issues such as resume after refresh, large cache lookup error, and progress stoppage.
공식 이펙트 전체 설정에서 기본 공격·스킬·상태 이펙트를 공식 표현으로: Full official effects now use official visuals for normal attacks, skills, and status effects. Custom effects such as Voice of Mundane remain available.
아로마·인디고·포덴코 등을 포함한 공식 이펙트의 위치 보정을 개선했습니다: Position correction of official effects including Aroma, Indigo, Podenco, etc. has been improved.
미즈키 공격·스즈란 3스킬 등 배치 방향을 사용하는 공식 이펙트의 방향: The direction processing and update during maintenance of official effects that use the deployment direction, such as Mizuki's attack and Suzuran's 3 skills, have been corrected.
전투·증강 수정 및 서버 유지 관리 개선: Combat/Augment fixes and server maintenance improvements
The number of shields for Enemy Augment Shields II and III has been adjusted to 3 and 5, respectively.
비비아나의 특질을 전투 중 대미지를 8회 입힐 때마다 활성화된 라이타니엔: Viviana's trait has been changed to +2 each activated Laitanien and Casimir stack and +1 agility stack for every 8 damage inflicted during battle. When upgrading, the amount earned is doubled.
밴된 맹약과 오퍼레이터가 증강 및 무작위 지급 효과에 포함되지 않도록 수: Fixed banned Alliances and Operators to not be included in Augment and random payment effects.
보스 단일 피해 상한을 커스텀 설정에 추가했습니다. 기본값은 300,00: Boss single damage cap added to custom settings. The default is 300,000, and any excess damage will be applied at the cap instead of being nullified. Setting it to 0 disables restrictions.
중첩 상한 해제 시 전투 중 중첩 표시가 999에서 잘리던 문제를 수정했: Fixed an issue where the stack display during combat would be cut off at 999 when the stack cap was lifted.
임시 대기석의 오퍼레이터가 자동 정리될 때 장착 장비가 사라지던 문제를: Fixed an issue where equipped equipment would disappear when an operator in a temporary standby area is automatically cleared. If there is no space to return the equipment, we will postpone clean-up.
이전 버전의 전체 접속 연결이 0이면 방이 남아 있어도 해당 버전을 종료: Changed the previous version to terminate that version even if there are rooms remaining if the overall connection count is 0. The latest version will be maintained.
이전 버전 정리 및 배포 공간 부족 시 사용하지 않는 Docker 빌드: Improved cleanup of older versions and automatic cleanup of unused Docker build caches when deployment space is low.
보스 스펙 설정이 일반 보스전·히든 보스전의 보스와 부위에 적용되도록 수: Boss spec settings have been modified to apply to bosses and parts of regular boss battles and hidden boss battles. Wanted bosses and remaining enemies follow existing enemy spec settings.
Fixed an issue where the maximum HP multiplier was missing from actual boss battle shared health. Fixed an issue where some bosses' own attack speed corrections would override their custom settings.
사키코 전용 전투 구현이 연결되지 않아 마법 음표와 전용 효과가 적용되지: Fixed an issue where magic notes and exclusive effects were not applied due to Sakiko's dedicated combat implementation not being connected.
증강 조정 · 전투 수정 · 롤링 업데이트 안정화: Augment Adjustments · Combat Modifications · Stabilization of Rolling Updates
보스 스펙 조정을 추가했습니다. 기존 적 스펙 조정은 보스를 제외한 적에: Boss spec adjustments have been added. Adjustments to existing enemy specifications apply to enemies excluding bosses, and bosses and boss parts can be set separately.
맹약 이름이 들어간 증강에 해당 맹약 아이콘을 적용하고 효과에 맞지 않던: The corresponding Alliance icon was applied to the Augment containing the Alliance name, and the icon that did not match the effect was modified.
소드마스터 I·II·III의 추가 공격 확률을 각각 15%·25%·35%: The additional attack probability of Sword Master I, II, and III has been changed to 15%, 25%, and 35%, respectively, and Victoria's attack power increase per equipment has been changed to 35%.
돌파가 전체 HP 감소량에 더해지던 문제를 수정했습니다. 일반 전투·협력: Fixed an issue where breakthrough was adding to total HP reduction. In normal combat and cooperative defense, HP is reduced by 2 for each enemy, and the upper limit of round HP reduction follows the existing rules.
최대 HP가 바뀔 때 실제 피해 없이 체력바에 흰 잔상이 생기던 문제를: Fixed an issue where a white afterimage would appear on the health bar when maximum HP changed without any actual damage.
적 모듈이 중복 로드되더라도 생성·사망 효과가 한 번만 등록되도록 수정했: Even if enemy modules are loaded multiple times, creation and death effects have been modified to register only once.
라우터의 메모리 한도를 늘리고 모듈 변환 캐시와 동시 요청 처리를 개선했: Increased the router's memory limit and improved the module translation cache and concurrent request handling. Fixed an issue where the router could shut down if a request was canceled during a websocket connection.
리소스 압축과 조건부 요청을 유지하고, 버전별 주소 때문에 이미지·음원·: We maintained resource compression and conditional requests, and fixed an issue where image, sound source, and font caches were re-downloaded due to version-specific addresses. Battle data is separated by version.
신규 버전 활성화 후 기존 버전을 최대 2시간 유지합니다. 최초 안내와: After activating a new version, the existing version will be maintained for up to 2 hours. Along with the initial guidance, notifications are displayed for the remaining time of 1 hour, 30 minutes, 10 minutes, 5 minutes, and 1 minute, and when the deadline expires, the existing version of the room and game ends.
최신 버전을 유지하면서 이전 버전만 강제로 종료하는 관리 스크립트를 추가: Added an administrative script to force quit older versions while maintaining the latest version. When replacing a router, the deployment and maintenance scripts are also updated.
전투 효과 및 업데이트 안내 핫픽스: Combat Effects and Update Information Hotfix
롤링 업데이트 환경에서 전투 데이터가 분리되어 맹약 등 전투 효과가 적용: Fixed an issue where combat data was separated in the rolling update environment and combat effects such as Alliances were not applied.
서버 업데이트 안내에 닫기 버튼을 추가했습니다. 현재 버전과 일치하면 안: A close button has been added to the server update notification. Fixed the prompt to disappear if it matches the current version.
증강 추가 · 관전 연동 · 롤링 운영 현황: Addition of Augment, spectator linkage, rolling operation status
기존 알뜰살뜰·헤드헌팅·소드마스터·아츠 마스터의 등급 표기를 변경했습니다: The rank notation for the existing Thrifty Saltteul, Headhunting, Sword Master, and Arts Master has been changed. The payment quantity for existing headhunting has been changed to 5 people.
소드마스터 또는 아츠 마스터를 획득하면 같은 계열의 다른 등급도 이후 선: Once you acquire Sword Master or Arts Master, other grades in the same series will not appear in future options.
관전자에게 현재 관전 중인 대상의 아군 증강 선택지를 표시합니다. 선택창: Shows spectators the option to augment allies for the target they are currently spectating. The separate target selection menu in the selection window has been removed.
체력바의 흰 피해 잔상을 복구했습니다. 마지막 피해 후 0.3초 안에 사: The white damage afterimage on the health bar has been restored. It disappears within 0.3 seconds after the last damage and has been modified to not remain for long when recovering or changing maximum HP.
차단 공사 같은 구조물이 최대 HP 감소와 초당 HP 감소 증강의 영향을: Structures such as blocking construction have been modified so that they are not affected by maximum HP reduction and HP per second reduction Augment.
The separate selection path for Lemuen's 3 skills has been linked to the implementation of dedicated aiming and artillery fire.
Changed the ceremonial bell to the Laitanien bell and modified related text.
나란투야 전략의 지급 후보를 원본의 지속형 전투 장비로 제한했습니다. 소: Candidates for the Narantuya strategy have been limited to the original persistent combat gear. Consumable, economical, immediate payment type equipment and custom equipment will not appear.
이그제큐터 1스킬이 기본 스킨과 다른 스킨에서도 기본 공격 모션을 유지하: Executive 1 skill has been modified to maintain the basic attack motion even in skins different from the default skin.
롤링 업데이트에서 주소의 버전 경로를 숨기도록 수정했습니다. 새로고침·재: Fixed to hide version path in address in rolling updates. Refreshing and reconnecting maintain the same game version, and a router update is required to reflect operation.
별도 운영 현황 페이지 /status/를 추가했습니다. 5초마다 플레이어: A separate operation status page /status/ has been added. Every 5 seconds, it displays the number of players, AI, spectators, rooms, games, server version, and uptime.
Added version status and overall total API to the rolling update router. Indicates unresponsive servers and does not include room codes or administrative credentials in public counts.
v0.2.6c 이미지를 최초 롤링 업데이트 설치 기준으로 사용합니다. 최: We will use the v0.2.6c image as the basis for the initial rolling update installation. The initial conversion takes place after all existing rooms and games are closed, and automatic deployment remains disabled until installation and verification are completed.
증강 확장 · 투표 선택 · 전투 및 프리셋 수정: Augment expansion · Vote selection · Battle and preset modification
신규 아군·적 증강을 추가하고 효과에 맞는 위기협약 및 맹약 아이콘을 적: New ally and enemy Augments have been added, and crisis Alliance and Alliance icons have been applied to match the effect. Harmony Augments activate Harmony and do not appear in games with the default Harmony rules turned on.
아군·적 증강 선택 시간을 각각 120초로 변경했습니다. 혼자 또는 AI: The Augment selection time for allies and enemies has been changed to 120 seconds each. There is no time limit when playing alone or against AI, and the effect takes effect after a 3-second countdown after completing the selection.
적 증강을 투표로 선택하는 커스텀 규칙을 추가했습니다. 세 증강과 전체: Added custom rule to vote on enemy Augments. Vote on the three augments and all rerolls, and if there is a tie for the most votes, the decision is made at random. A full reroll consumes the chance and resets the vote.
이미 선택한 동일 증강은 다시 등장하지 않습니다. 다른 등급의 증강은 별: The same Augment you have already selected will not appear again. Augments of different grades are treated separately, and past unselected candidates are reset when exhausted.
기습 I·II의 지속시간을 30초, 사르곤의 공격속도 중첩 지속시간을 1: The duration of Surprise I and II has been changed to 30 seconds, and Sargon's attack speed stack duration has been changed to 15 seconds. Jeong Yehwa was changed to the doctor's head, and Alteulsaltteul was changed to Alteolsaltteul I and II according to the grade.
예견은 3등급 이하 오퍼레이터의 가격만 1 감소시킵니다. 소드마스터의 추: Foresight only reduces the price of Operators of level 3 and below by 1. The Sword Master's additional attack probability is 33%, the additional attack interval is 0.18 seconds, and it performs a chain attack after the ongoing attack ends.
관전자가 참가자별 아군 증강 선택지를 확인할 수 있으며, 선택한 카드에: Spectators can check the ally Augment options for each participant, and the selection completion is indicated on the selected card. The ally and enemy selection titles are displayed in mint and red, respectively.
웹소켓 압축을 비활성화했습니다. 실험실 진입 시 getConfig 모듈: Disabled websocket compression. Fixed getConfig module error when entering lab.
Fixed the enemy Augment's HP regeneration not being applied to hit-type enemies.
체력바의 흰색 잔상을 제거하고, 적 미리보기에서 전투로 전환할 때 HP: Removed the white afterimage on the health bar and fixed the HP display to be restored when switching from enemy preview to combat. Separated render targets for spine clipping models.
빠른 연속 공격의 idle 전환을 실제 공격 모션 완료 시점에 맞췄습니다: The idle transition of a quick continuous attack has been adjusted to the completion of the actual attack motion. Fixed an issue where surprise redeployment was displayed as a death effect and an issue where Ebenholtz skill 3 was activated without an elite or leader in range.
선호·선발 프리셋의 진영 연동, 재연결 시 적용 및 빠른 진영 변경 처리: The faction linkage of preferred/selected presets, application upon reconnection, and quick faction change processing have been modified.
오퍼레이터 검색을 한국어 이름과 초성으로 할 수 있도록 검색 필터를 정리: We have organized the search filter so that you can search for operators using Korean names and initial consonants.
적 증강 목록을 게임 정보 창 내부에 맞춰 축소하고 스크롤 영역을 수정했: The enemy Augment list has been reduced to fit inside the game information window and the scroll area has been modified. Reduced mobile deployment cost display size.
원본 v0.2.6 · 증강 모드 · 전투 개선: Original v0.2.6 · Augmented Mode · Combat Improvements
원본 v0.2.6의 리소스 캐시·압축·트래픽 진단·배치 연출 개선을 반영: Reflected improvements in resource cache, compression, traffic diagnosis, and deployment presentation from the original v0.2.6.
게임 정보의 커스텀 설정·적 증강 탭 하단이 눌리지 않는 문제를 수정했습: Fixed an issue where the bottom of the Custom Settings/Enemy Augment tab in game information could not be clicked.
Sword Master's additional attack interval has been adjusted to 0.2 seconds.
Changes from the original v0.2.5 and map resources and loading methods have been integrated.
커스텀 규칙에 증강 모드를 추가했습니다. 4·7·10라운드에 각자 세 가: Added augmented mode to custom rules. In rounds 4, 7, and 10, each player selects one of three ally Augments, and then the leader selects the Augment to apply to all enemies.
실버·골드·프리즘의 기본 등장 확률은 25%·50%·25%이며 가중치를: The default appearance probability of Silver, Gold, and Prism is 25%, 50%, and 25%, and the weight can be set. Silver does not appear three times in a row.
아군·적 증강의 리롤 횟수를 따로 설정할 수 있으며 기본은 선택지당 1회: You can set the number of rerolls for ally and enemy Augment separately, and the default is 1 per option. Past options will not appear again until candidates are exhausted.
If there is more than one human player, there is a 60 second time limit on each selection. Playing alone or against AI, there is no time limit and a 3-second countdown will appear after your selection is complete.
아군 증강은 효과 목록 왼쪽에 표시하고 적 증강은 게임 정보의 전용 탭에: Friendly Augments are displayed on the left of the effect list, and enemy Augments can be found in a dedicated tab in the game information. Saves your selections to your edition history.
소드마스터는 공격 시 35% 확률로 추가 공격을 발동하며 추가 공격도 연: When attacking, the Sword Master has a 35% chance to make an additional attack and can also chain additional attacks. It has been modified so that additional attacks continue after the ongoing attack motion ends.
The corresponding Alliance icon has been applied to the Alliance Augment, and the harmony support Augment has been excluded. Display the name and quantity of the equipment issued in the equipment support description. Changed Glorious Evolution and Archmage to Blessing of Ishamla and Arts Master respectively.
전투 중 생성된 적을 처치해도 진행도 카운트가 증가하지 않도록 수정했습니: The progress count has been modified so that killing enemies created during battle does not increase the progress count. HP deduction from missed enemies is maintained.
차단 공사의 크기가 준비와 전투에서 달라지는 문제와 수둔 닌자의 회전 모: Fixed an issue where the size of the blockade would vary between preparation and combat, and the Sudun Ninja's rotation motion would not play.
배치 코스트 표시를 키워 오른쪽 아래에 배치하고 효과·증강 목록의 간격과: The deployment cost display has been enlarged and placed at the bottom right, and the spacing of the effect/Augment list and the size of enemy Augment information have been organized.
라이타니엔 오퍼레이터의 누락된 공격 이펙트·사운드와 한국어 표기를 보완했: Laitanien Operator's missing attack effects/sounds and Korean notation have been supplemented.
진영에 연동한 선호 프리셋이 잘못 연결되는 문제를 수정했습니다. 드롭다운: Fixed an issue where preferred presets linked to factions were linked incorrectly. Fixed white square in dropdown and Korean spelling in lab search.
에벤홀츠 특질의 공격력 증가를 라이타니엔 3중첩당 일반 +1%·승급 +2: The attack power increase of the Ebenholtz trait has been changed to general +1% and promotion +2% per 3 stacks of Laitanien.
레싱의 배치 특질이 활성화된 기습 중첩도 함께 지급하며 재배치 시간이 5: A surprise stack with Lessing's Deployment trait activated is also provided, and deployment time is reduced by 50%.
공통 전략은 개인 전략과 중복되어도 각각 적용되며 비활성화한 전략도 공통: Common strategies are applied even if they overlap with personal strategies, and disabled strategies can also be set as common strategies. Quintus' mutant cells are not synthesized separately.
랜덤 전략 선택 시 추가 HP 5를 지급합니다. Touch 중복 시 전략: When choosing a random strategy, an additional 5 HP is given. When Touch overlaps, the stats of the strategically deployed Medical Operator are increased by 50% for each additional overlap.
새 게임은 새 버전에서 시작하고 진행 중인 게임은 기존 버전을 유지하는: We've added a rolling deployment feature and installation instructions that will allow new games to start at a new version and games in progress to remain at the old version. Initial conversion requires separate installation and automatic deployment is activated after setup.
커스텀 규칙 확장 · 랜덤 전략 · 전투 수정: Custom rule expansions, random strategies, combat modifications
상점 재고 설정을 자동·1~8인·무제한으로 통합했습니다. 자동은 4인 기: Store inventory settings have been integrated to automatic, 1 to 8 people, and unlimited. Automatic does not exceed the 4-person limit, and when specifying the number of people, it is adjusted in proportion to the basic stock of 4 people.
허수아비 모드를 추가했습니다. 보스·히든 보스가 실험실과 동일한 제셀톤: Added Scarecrow mode. The boss/hidden boss is replaced by Jesselton Williams, the same as the laboratory, and appears as a damage measurement target without movement, attack, or skills.
아군 스펙 조정 탭을 추가했습니다. 기본 스탯·공격 속도·최대 SP·초기: Added ally spec adjustment tab. Basic stats, attack speed, maximum SP, initial SP, SP recovery amount, etc. can be set as percentages, and the default value is 100%.
랜덤 전략을 전략 목록 맨 앞에 추가했습니다. 여러 참가자가 선택할 수: Added random strategy to the front of the strategy list. Multiple players can choose, and the unselected strategies are randomized in the order of their selection at the start of the game. If overlap is allowed, the same strategy can be assigned. AI is not optional and cannot be disabled in customs.
Fixed Duck Road's additional enemies not appearing in boss and hidden boss battles.
When spectating individually in 8-person cooperative defense, the Alliance of the spectating target is displayed.
Fixed an issue where Changnier's 2nd skill's exit motion was displayed as an attack motion. Skills that are activated upon deployment also immediately attempt a surprise move, and we have confirmed that Changnier's 2nd skill and Ines' 3rd skill attack after moving.
속세의 음 기본 피해를 50에서 80으로 변경했습니다. 매초 피해는 80: Voice of Mundane base damage changed from 50 to 80. Damage per second is 80 + 1% of the caster's ATK + 0.01% of their ATK per Leithanien stack.
협동 시뮬레이션 카드 안에서 4인/8인을 선택할 수 있습니다. 8인 대기: You can choose 4 or 8 players in the cooperative simulation card. The 8-person waiting room seating/chat, team list, board records, and results screens have been adjusted to match the number of players.
8인 모드는 맹약·오퍼레이터 밴이 없으며, 오퍼레이터 밴 제외 설정을 제: There is no Alliance/operator ban in 8-player mode, and the operator ban exclusion setting has been removed.
기물과 장비의 공유 재고는 4인 모드와 동일합니다. 간이 통신기·호출모듈: The shared inventory of props and equipment is the same as in 4-player mode. We doubled the inventory of simple communication devices, call modules, and beacons, and reduced the purchase cost by 1. Maintain personal inventory of the starting operator. Boss battles take place on up to four two-player battlefields.
연합방어에서 기습의 우선 대상에게 착지할 수 없을 때 다른 전장의 대상을: In combined defense, when a surprise attack cannot land on its priority target, it checks for targets on other battlefields and places Touch medical units on each of the four battlefields. Maintain the camera order of the 8-person joint defense and move to the next viewpoint with the left arrow.
협력방어는 기존 맵을 가로로 이어 최대 4명이 차례로 방어합니다. 원본에: Cooperative defense involves up to four people taking turns defending the existing map horizontally. It applies 3D maps corresponding to the original and central zones, devices, and routes, and provides an overall view and individual cameras in the four zones.
8인 협력방어 시간은 기존의 4배입니다. 공동 선택지는 스크롤 없는 같은: The 8-person cooperative defense time is 4 times the existing time. The common choice is displayed as 9 cards of the same size without scrolling.
전투를 일찍 포기해도 아직 등장하지 않은 적을 놓친 적과 협력방어에 반영: Even if you give up the battle early, enemies that have not yet appeared will be reflected in your cooperative defense with missed enemies. Abandoning cooperative defense is only applied when all human defenders on the battlefield agree.
불필요한 미리보기 타일을 제거하고 도시맵에 원본 광원 보정을 적용했습니다: Removed unnecessary preview tiles and applied original lighting correction to the city map. The expansion map is created in advance during preparation, and background work is performed at a waiting interval after the first battlefield is displayed.
일반·히든 보스 목록에 딜 측정용 제셀톤 윌리엄스를 추가했습니다. 갑주의: Added Jesselton Williams for damage measurement to the list of regular and hidden bosses. The armor's basic stats and fixed attack range are used, and the original Jesselton model is displayed three times. There are no attack, movement, skills, or escort enemies, and stats can be changed or reset in real time.
준비 미리보기와 실제 전투에 제셀톤의 이름·모델·피격 정보를 동일하게 적: Jesselton's name, model, and hit information are applied identically to the preparation preview and actual battle, and the elapsed time is displayed instead of the time limit during battle.
실험실 배치 한도를 15명으로 고정하고 인사부 파일을 장비 목록에서 제외: Fixed lab staffing limit at 15 people and removed human resources files from equipment list.
배치와 오퍼레이터·장착 장비를 저장하고 불러올 수 있습니다. 같은 맵에서: You can save and load layouts, operators, and equipped equipment. Restore the layout on the same map, and empty the waiting area on a different map and move the saved lineup. Operator settings and selection settings are not saved, and operators not currently selected are not loaded.
전투 중과 종료 안내에 재시작 버튼을 추가했습니다. 전투 시작 전 배치·: A restart button has been added to notifications during and after battle. Before the battle begins, you can return to deployment, equipment, and Alliance stacking to prepare again.
실시간 피해 그래프를 설정 버튼 묶음 위로 옮기고 피해 유형 표시를 통일: We moved the real-time damage graph above the settings button set and unified the display of damage types. The lab will hide your preference marks and apply the skin you set.
속세의 음 매초 피해를 50 + 시전자 공격력의 1% + 라이타니엔 중첩: Voice of Mundane damage per second changed to 50 + 1% of the caster's ATK + 0.01% ATK per Leithanien stack, using ATK at the time of application.
동일 오퍼레이터가 동일 적에게 속세의 음을 다시 부여하는 대기 시간은 0: Reapplying Voice of Mundane has a 0.1-second cooldown per Operator/target pair. At the 6-Operator threshold, its base 10-second duration gains 1 second per 25 stacks.
에벤홀츠 특질은 라이타니엔 3중첩당 공격력 일반 +2%·승급 +4%입니다: Ebenholtz's trait is general attack power +2% and promotion +4% per 3 stacks of Laitanien. Bibiana is level 5 and has added the Casimir Alliance. Diamante's name has been corrected and the talent activation limit has been changed to 5 per battle.
비비아나의 특질은 속세의 음을 5회 적용할 때마다 활성화된 라이타니엔/기: Every 5 applications of Voice of Mundane, Viviana's trait grants active Leithanien/Swift stacks: +2/+1 normally or +4/+2 when promoted, up to 10 triggers per battle.
위치킹 보상을 다음 휴식 기간 진입 시 상점 등급 이하의 오퍼레이터로 지: Witch King rewards will be paid to operators of store level or lower upon entering the next rest period. We maintain a limit of one per round.
속세의 음 중첩은 체력바 왼쪽의 전용 아이콘과 숫자로 표시하고, 적용된: Voice of Mundane stacks appear as an icon and count to the left of the HP bar, with a purple treble clef on affected enemies. Damage is recorded for the owning Operator without floating damage numbers.
에벤홀츠 2스킬 잔영 등 소환물의 피해에도 소유자의 속세의 음을 적용하고: Damage from summons, including Ebenholz's Skill 2 remnants, also applies the owner's Voice of Mundane and shares the same caster/target cooldown.
HP 감소 상한 해제, 팀원 모두에게 적용되는 공통 전략, 일반 라운드: Added HP reduction cap removal, common strategy for all team members, and general round count settings. The default number of normal rounds is 13, and bosses and hidden bosses appear after the set round. The 13 round rule applies for additional normal rounds.
시작 조건 재추첨에도 커스텀 밴 규칙을 유지합니다. 게임 정보의 커스텀: Custom ban rules will be maintained for starting condition redraws. You can check the settings applied to the game in the Custom Settings tab of the game information.
선호·선발 프리셋 목록을 각각 한 줄 코드로 생성·복사·불러올 수 있습니: You can create, copy, and load preferred and selected preset lists with one line of code each. You cannot apply preset codes from one type to another, and loaded lists will not change operator settings until you apply them directly.
선발 목록에서 등록한 오퍼레이터를 먼저 표시합니다. 대기실의 관전자 전용: The registered operators are displayed first in the selection list. The spectator-only personnel information text in the waiting room has been removed.
힐이야 2스킬은 부상 아군이 없어도 SP가 준비되면 자동 발동합니다. 라: Heal's 2nd skill automatically activates when SP is ready even if there are no injured allies. Lapland the Decadenza maintains skill motion and performs basic attacks even during skill 3.
기습 강타 스킬은 공격 중 공격력·최대 HP 증가를 적용하고 공격 종료: The surprise strike skill increases attack power and maximum HP during an attack and is released when the attack ends. A long-distance strike maintains attack power until it hits the target when fired. When performing a surprise teleport, the initial SP is added to the current SP.
퀸투스의 돌연변이 세포는 장비 승급 효과의 대상에서 제외합니다. 보스에게: Quintus' mutant cells are excluded from the equipment upgrade effect. Added global notification when damage equal to 10% of total HP is inflicted on a boss.
SP 회복 효과의 실제 회복량을 청록색 숫자로 표시합니다. 오디오 중단·: The actual recovery amount of the SP recovery effect is displayed in cyan numbers. Restores playback from audio interruption/termination status and prevents infinite waiting for sound file requests/decoding.
선발 오퍼레이터의 누락된 공격 이펙트를 보완했습니다. 에이야퍄들라 2스킬: Fixed the missing attack effect of the starting operator. Eyjafjalla's 2nd skill applies a normal attack motion, and skill 3 applies a volcano motion, and they are displayed correctly in the basic, summer, and Sanrio skins and in the upward direction.
무적 상태의 적은 아군의 공격·범위 타겟팅에서 제외합니다. 배치 이펙트: Enemies that are invincible are excluded from allies' attacks and range targeting. Placement effect particles were fixed to world coordinates to prevent their position from being misaligned when the camera moves.
Enemy preview hotkey E has been added and can be changed in hotkey settings. Even if the placement of the spectating target is updated, the enemy preview view is maintained.
피해 유형을 물리(붉은색), 마법(푸른색), 원소(청록색), 속세의 음(: Standardized damage types in records and graphs: Physical (red), Arts (blue), Elemental (teal), Voice of Mundane (purple), True (white), and Unspecified (gray). Refined summary/detail tabs and graph layout.
라이타니엔 밸런스 · 중첩 표시 · 진영 연동: Laitanien Balance · stacks Display · Faction Linkage
속세의 음의 별도 피해 증가 효과를 제거하고 매초 피해를 시전자 공격력의: Removed the separate Voice of Mundane damage bonus. Damage per second is now 5% of the caster's ATK + 0.015% per Alliance stack.
Added a 0.2-second cooldown per Operator for Voice of Mundane. Simultaneous area attacks apply it separately to different targets.
Baseline has been changed to level 5, and Ebenholtz has been changed to level 6 and basic 3 skills.
디아만테 특질을 라이타니엔/아케인 중첩 일반 +2/+1·승급 +4/+2,: Changed the Diamante trait to Laitanien/Arcane stacks normal +2/+1, promoted +4/+2, up to 6 times per battle.
위치킹의 황역 오퍼레이터 지급을 라운드당 최대 1회로 제한하고 설명에 명: The Witch King's Yellow Area Operator payment has been limited to a maximum of once per round and stated in the description.
Show Voice of Mundane stacks in small text directly above the target's HP bar.
라이타니엔을 채팅 진영 선택과 선호 오퍼레이터 프리셋 연동에 추가했습니다: Added Laitanien to chat faction selection and preferred operator presets. In chat, you can only select a custom faction in games that have it enabled.
The changed Alliance, trait, and strategy descriptions have been organized to match the existing writing style.
상점 재고·맹약 중첩 상한선 해제, 조화 기본 활성화, 아군 HP 공유: The store inventory/Alliance stack cap has been lifted, basic harmony has been activated, and ally HP sharing rules have been added.
Fixed an issue where the effect at the bottom of the fury board was obscured by the terrain in front. Glow rises from the outline of the two sheets of the original map.
배치 한도를 4~12명으로 설정할 수 있으며 인사부 파일은 설정한 한도에: You can set the placement limit from 4 to 12 people, and the HR file increases by 1 person from the set limit.
적 HP·공격력·방어력·마법 저항·이동 속도·공격 속도 비율을 설정할 수: You can set the enemy HP, attack power, defense power, magic resistance, movement speed, and attack speed ratio.
판 기록에 당시 커스텀 설정과 수치를 저장하며 결과 다시보기와 오래된 요: Custom settings and values at the time are saved in the plate history and can be viewed in replays of results and old summary records.
라이타니엔 현재 효과에 실제 지속시간과 중첩 보너스를 표시합니다. 400: Laitanien Displays the actual duration and stacking bonus for the current effect. At 400 stacks and 6 synergies, the stack bonus is +13 seconds, the duration increase is +18 seconds, and a total of 23 seconds, and the increase coefficient information per stack has been removed from the current effect.
커스텀 설정에서 선택할 때만 라이타니엔 맹약·오퍼레이터 8명·장비 2종·: The Laitanien Alliance, 8 operators, 2 types of equipment, Ebenholtz's Alliance, and Witch King strategy are added only when selected in the custom settings. Alliances are also added to Carnelian and Eyjafjalla the Kvit Asuka, and the custom core Alliance +1 ban rule is maintained.
속세의 음 피해 증가량은 기본 +20%·중첩당 +0.25%입니다. 6시너: Voice of Mundane gains +20% damage plus +0.25% per stack. The 6-Operator effect reduces enemy damage and movement speed by 25%; duration is 10 seconds plus 1 second per 30 stacks.
속세의 음은 중첩별 지속시간과 시전자별 피해 통계를 유지하며 같은 시점: Voice of Mundane preserves independent stack durations and per-caster damage statistics, combining simultaneous damage. Hide damage numbers and highlight the name. Removed the stack-count debug label above targets in production.
에벤홀츠 특질은 3중첩당 공격력 일반 +1%·승급 +2%, 디아만테는 라: Ebenholtz's trait was adjusted to general attack power +1% and promotion +2% per 3 stacks, Diamante gained stacks when applying Laitanien/Arcane Alliance and debilitating damage, and Eyjafjäldla to Laitanien/Swift general +3/+2 and promotion +6/+4. Viviana retains the existing stack gain trait and the maximum limit of 10 per battle. Bibiana was changed to level 6, and Ebenholtz was changed to level 5.
위치킹 최대 HP는 24이며 <라이타니엔> 40중첩마다 [황역]이 반복: The maximum positioning HP is 24. <Leithanien> Every 40 overruns, it's paid repeatedly. We applied a Wiki NPC-based strategy icon.
체르니 부가 맹약을 고수로 수정하고 신규 오퍼레이터의 전투 진입 소실을: Corrected Czerny’s Add-on Alliance and fixed new Operators disappearing at battle start. Added Operators are excluded from the starter roster.
에벤홀츠 2스킬 잔영이 주변 8칸의 보스 피격 영역에도 반응하도록 수정했: Ebenholtz's 2nd skill remnant has been modified to react to the boss attack area within 8 squares around it.
실험실에 인사부 파일과 접고 펼칠 수 있는 실시간 피해 그래프를 추가했습: Added human resources files and collapsible real-time damage graph to the lab. Displays damage per second per type and cumulative damage per operator.
조건부 은신·주변 적에게 은신 부여 능력은 미리보기에서 기본 은신으로 표: Conditional stealth and the ability to grant stealth to nearby enemies are not displayed as default stealth in the preview.
커스텀 설정의 규칙 분류에 전략 중복 선택 허용을 추가했습니다. 수동·자: Added Allowing duplicate strategy selection to rule classification in custom settings. Applies to both manual and automatic selection.
게임 정보에서 이번 게임의 특훈 적 3종을 표시합니다. 적 미리보기 은신: The game information displays the 3 special enemies in this game. Enemy preview stealth effects are judged based on actual abilities rather than special training classifications, and exclusive animations are maintained.
Fixed duplicate input while entering room code in Korean and the display order on the left side of equipment. The equipment slot is displayed to the right of the level up button, and the dividing line is displayed to the right of the equipment slot.
최근 관전 카메라 자동 재조정 변경을 되돌리고 협력방어 2인 진입을 전체: We have reverted the recent change to automatically re-adjust the spectator camera and set the cooperative defense 2-player entry to full view. The give up battle button is hidden during boss/hidden boss battles.
A timer displays the 3-second remaining time after co-selection is completed.
실험실에서는 선호 오퍼레이터 표시를 숨기고 준비 중 스킨·설정 변경을 실: In the laboratory, the preferred operator display is hidden and changes to skins and settings during preparation are reflected in actual battles.
황제의 은총은 일반 최대 HP +25%·공격 속도 +25, 승급 +40%: The Emperor's Grace is normal maximum HP +25%, attack speed +25, promotion +40%, +40, and the damage coefficient exclusive to Ursus is 10% of maximum HP.
메인화면에 리소스 재다운로드 버튼을 추가했습니다. 리소스 캐시만 초기화하: A resource redownload button has been added to the main screen. This only clears the resource cache and preserves settings and edition history.
실험실 인원 기준 · 전투 HUD 수정: Lab personnel standards and combat HUD modifications
공동 선택 이벤트에서 모두 선택한 뒤 잔류 시간을 1초에서 3초로 늘렸습: Increased the dwell time after selecting all in the carousel event from 1 second to 3 seconds.
설정 탭을 스크롤 영역에서 분리해 내용이 탭 위로 보이는 문제를 수정했습: Fixed an issue where the Settings tab was separated from the scroll area, causing content to appear above the tab.
보스 설정에 1~4인 기준을 추가했습니다. 실제 플레이는 1인이며, 2~: Added 1 to 4 player criteria to boss settings. Actual play is 1 player, while 2-4 player settings use enemy values ​​from a cooperative simulation and boss health based on everyone's survival.
The number of changes displayed on the operator settings/custom settings button has been restored.
It maintains your current base HP, but displays the number of enemies missed and the HP scheduled to be reduced. Actual HP is deducted after the battle ends.
전투 포기 버튼을 상단 카운트다운 영역 안에 배치해 화면 요소와 겹치지: The give up battle button has been placed within the countdown area at the top so that it does not overlap with screen elements.
관전 중 전투 프레임이 단계 전환보다 먼저 도착해도 실제 전투 시점으로: Even if the battle frame arrives before the stage transition while spectating, it is adjusted back to the actual battle time. Camera settings for automatic and manual spectator switching have been matched.
뮤엘시스·다마즈티의 확정 지급과 화권 복제가 상점 재고에 막히지 않도록: Muelsis and Damazti's confirmed payment and currency copy have been modified so that they are not blocked by store inventory. Inventory ignore payments do not deduct inventory even after synthesis, installation, or return, and also apply to operator duplication and promotion of mimicry materials. It has been modified so that equipment selection rewards can be received as a temporary standby even if the regular standby is full. We also checked the provision of temporary standby seats, which have the characteristic of directly providing equipment.
원본 0.2.4 이식 · 전투·선발·충전 표시 수정: Original 0.2.4 port · Combat, selection, charging display modifications
게임 서버 없이 실행되는 실험실을 추가했습니다. 난이도를 선택해 진입한: Added a lab that runs without a game server. After selecting the difficulty level and entering, set the map, boss, and strategy, and save the results of a freely prepared round in existing statistics.
설정 화면에 전장 썸네일·보스 초상화·전략 아이콘을 사용하고, 항목별 높: The battlefield thumbnail, boss portrait, and strategy icons were used on the settings screen, and the height of each item was unified and internal scrolling was applied. We have supplemented the untranslated sentences in the boss description.
상점 위치에 7칸 페이지형 실험실 메뉴를 배치했습니다. 초성 검색과 탭별: A 7-page laboratory menu has been placed in the store location. It supports initial consonant search and maintains filters by tab, and does not display prices, equipment without combat effects, or Alliances without stacks.
획득 특질·상점 보상·자동 중첩 획득을 차단하고 수동 설정과 전투·스탯: Block acquisition of acquired traits, store rewards, and automatic stacking, while maintaining manual settings, combat, and stat effects. Only registered operators can obtain it.
실험실 판 기록은 실험실로 분류하고 승률·전략·누적 전투 등 종합 통계에: Laboratory version records are classified as laboratory and excluded from comprehensive statistics such as win rate, strategy, and cumulative battles. Interrupted versions are not recorded.
전투 통계의 컨트롤·요약·그래프 배치를 정리하고, 캐서린 지원 장치를 마: The control, summary, and graph layout of battle statistics has been organized, and Catherine's support devices are displayed without diamond frames. Fixed line breaks in Alliance stack numbers and Korean keystrokes in room codes.
상단 탭에서 오퍼레이터/선발 설정을 전환하고 탭에 맞는 프리셋 버튼을 표: The top tabs toggle operator/selector settings and display preset buttons appropriate for the tab. Free up list name width, allow details to be selected across rows, and bring key commitments up front.
사이트 제목을 위수 협의로 통일하고 단축키 설정에서 키 입력을 받지 못하: We unified the site title to the upper level and fixed an issue where key input could not be received in shortcut key settings.
오퍼레이터·선발 설정에 세로 목록 보기를 추가했습니다. 한 줄에 단계·직: Vertical list view has been added to operator/selection settings. You can display stages, occupations, Alliances, skills, and modules as icons in one line, and set the skills, modules, and selection stages right away.
선발 목록 초상화 크기를 일반 목록과 맞추고 선발 버튼을 - / V /: The selection list portrait size has been adjusted to the normal list, and the selection buttons have been organized into - / V / VI. Unselected Operators will not display any level badges.
특질의 통합 설명과 내부 효과 설명이 중복되는 부분을 정리했습니다. 별도: We have organized the overlap between the integrated description of traits and the description of internal effects. Separate activation conditions and actual effects are maintained.
관전 설정의 하단 안내를 제거하고 커스텀 확장 설정을 커스텀 설정으로 변: The bottom guidance in spectating settings has been removed and the custom expansion settings have been changed to custom settings. Distinguish between existing content and custom content in the Alliance/map list.
We've re-shot previews of 11 maps in the current renderer.
The doubling rule and individual exception values for the operator's common inventory before cooperative battles have been reflected. The starting operator uses existing personal inventory.
장비 공용 재고와 티어별 수량 제한을 상점·보상·이벤트·승급에 적용했습니: Equipment common inventory and tier-specific quantity restrictions have been applied to stores, rewards, events, and promotions. Standard equipment occupies 1 unit, upgraded equipment occupies 2 units, and inventory is returned after sale and consumption.
상업용 패키지를 동시 보유 2개 제한으로 변경했습니다. 의태물질은 남은: Changed the commercial package to a limit of 2 simultaneous possessions. Mimetic substances can be copied and merged even if there is no remaining inventory, and the actual quantity held is reflected in the inventory.
기습 부활 후 도발·거리 기준으로 공격 대상을 다시 선정합니다. 스카디: After a surprise revival, the attack target is selected again based on provocation and distance. Prevented overlapping damage distribution and recursive propagation of Skadi the Corrupting Heart 1 skill and Indomitable.
해럴드 2스킬이 원소 손상만 있는 대상도 회복합니다. 제시카 더 리버레이: Harold's 2nd skill also heals targets that only have elemental damage. Jessica the Liberated's shield placement is limited to 4 adjacent spaces.
가문의 문장은 은신 해제 후 첫 실제 피해에 적용됩니다. 파인콘 2스킬의: The family emblem is applied to the first actual damage taken after coming out of stealth. Cumulative growth of Pinecone 2 skill is reset upon relocation.
클레멘티아 2스킬의 캡슐 범위·추가 피해·공중 적 발동 조건을 수정했습니: The capsule range, additional damage, and aerial enemy activation conditions for Clementia's 2nd skill have been modified. Reflected the preparatory phase exception of the Gladia/Stomach trait replicated by Ptilopsis.
샴페인 폭탄을 일반 아군 오라·고무·치유 대상과 분리했습니다. AI 팀원: Champagne bombs have been separated from normal friendly aura, inspiration, and healing targets. The timeout delay for boss fights with AI team members has been reflected, but the existing boss fight time multiplier has been maintained.
스와이어 디 엘리건트 위트의 금화를 머리 위에 표시합니다. 준비 단계 의: Swire the Elegant Wit's gold coin appears above your head. We have supplemented the general/promotion detailed figures reflecting preparation stage medical objects, skills, modules, and potential.
렌더러·이미지·맵 로딩 실패 시 재시도를 보완했습니다. 렌더러가 복구되어: Improved retry when rendering/image/map loading fails. Renderer recovery does not restart ongoing combat. The result summary scrolls internally, while retaining the bottom buttons, statistics, and chat.
평타에 붙는 장비 효과를 범위·연쇄 공격의 실제 피해 대상에도 적용합니다: Equipment effects that apply to basic attacks are also applied to actual damage targets from range and chain attacks. Prevents recursive activation of additional equipment damage, and maintains the existing standards for attack count stacking and drone attack speed increase.
카제마루 대역의 주변 3×3 공격 범위와 대공 능력을 적용하고 본체 복귀: Apply the surrounding 3×3 attack range and anti-air ability of Kazemaru's band, and restore the original range when returning to the main body. The remaining time in the puppeteer's role is displayed on the SP bar.
The puppeteer's replacement animation, such as Specter the Unchained, is also applied to the skin. Updates the standby rendering cache when switching skills/bands.
전술가의 주인이 사망하면 지원군과 분열한 소환물도 철수하고, 주인 재배치: If the tactician's owner dies, the reinforcements and the divided summons will also withdraw, and the reinforcements will be restored when the owner is relocated.
에어본·부유 상태의 상승 높이를 0.35칸으로 낮췄습니다. 본래 비행 유: The elevation height of the airborne/floating state has been reduced to 0.35 squares. The original flying unit's height and takeoff skills are maintained.
지마 3스킬의 시작 모션이 모델 로딩 중 누락되는 경로를 보완하고, 긴: Zima's 3rd skill's starting motion has been corrected for missing paths during model loading, and has been modified to prevent multiple hits from occurring at once in long updates. Maintains the first hit of 1.1 seconds and the existing 5 consecutive hits.
적이 공격 모션을 마친 후 이동하는 규칙을 유지하고, 긴 공격 모션의 과: Maintained the rule of enemies moving after completing their attack motion, and limited excessive compression of long attack motions.
Fixed an issue where some starter summons' magic attack effects were missing.
미스틱 캐스터 충전 표시를 축소해 SP바 아래로 이동했습니다. 에벤홀츠의: The Mystic Caster charge display has been reduced and moved below the SP bar. Ebenholz's extra charge and BEY's conversion charge also show the actual storage amount.
시작 조건 다시 추첨 버튼을 하단 조작 영역으로 정리하고, 비이의 이름을: The starting conditions and re-draw buttons have been organized into the bottom control area, and the name of B.I. has been modified. The results window chat was placed in the left area so that it does not obscure the result summary, statistics, and return buttons.
미사용 맵을 작은 작업 단위로 사전 생성하고 캐시를 재사용해 최초 전환: We pre-generated unused maps in small units of work and reused the cache to reduce the initial conversion burden. The existing boss battle/cooperative defense structure and direction will be maintained.
Added a red glow that follows the outline of the tiles on the original map's Fury Floor. It is not added to simple maps.
Spine 텍스처 페이지별 premultiplied alpha 처리를 보: Improved premultiplied alpha processing for each Spine texture page. The rest of the rendering continues even though there is no shadow image yet.
상점 장비칸을 왼쪽 끝에 두는 설정을 추가했습니다. 레벨업 시 새 기물칸: Added a setting to place the store equipment slot at the left end. Added a new prop slot to the left when leveling up and removed the small collapse button at the top of the store.
접기를 포함한 단축키를 설정할 수 있으며 접기 버튼에 현재 단축키를 표시: You can set shortcuts, including folding, and display the current shortcut on the folding button. Removed tail effect from melee weapons.
전투 중 누수에 따른 기지 HP 감소를 미리 표시하지 않고 전투가 끝나: Base HP reduction due to water leaks during battle is not displayed in advance, but is reflected when the battle is over and settled.
선발한 단계 버튼을 다시 누르면 선발이 해제됩니다. 미선발 버튼은 양쪽: If you press the selected level button again, selection will be cancelled. The unselected button releases both stages and preserves skill, module, and skin settings. We keep the stepwise selection of the prototype operator independent.
혼자 하는 연합방어는 자신의 전장 시점으로 시작합니다. 관전 중인 대상이: A combined defense played alone starts from your own battlefield perspective. When the target you are watching enters battle, the camera automatically switches to the corresponding battle camera.
공동 선택이 모두 끝나면 결과를 1초간 보여준 뒤 다음 단계로 넘어갑니다: When all co-selections are completed, the results are displayed for 1 second and then move on to the next step. The Chinese selection display on the strategy selection card has been corrected to Korean.
협력방어 최적화 · 선발 설정 복구 · 전투 통계 수정: Optimization of cooperative defense · Restoration of selection settings · Modification of battle statistics
협력방어 진입·퇴장 시 중복 맵 생성을 제거하고 최근 맵 GPU 리소스를: Eliminates duplicate map creation when entering or exiting cooperative defense and reuses recent map GPU resources. It also caches the original map analysis results.
협력방어 오른쪽 전투 구역의 잘못된 좌우반전을 수정했습니다. 보스전 배치: Fixed the incorrect left/right inversion of the right combat area of the cooperative defense. Boss battle placement and enemy paths are maintained.
처음 추가한 선발 오퍼레이터 5명의 스킨 목록을 복구하고 데이터 재생성: Restore the skin list for the first 5 starter operators added and maintain it when regenerating data. The skin resource index and Korean names have also been supplemented.
캐서린 특질의 장비 풀을 4티어 이하로 제한하고 돈 관련 장비와 특수 효: We limited the Catherine trait equipment pool to Tier 4 or lower and excluded money-related equipment and special effect hammers. Grade restrictions based on store level do not apply.
수배 투석기가 선딜 후 0.3초 간격으로 돌 3개를 발사하고, 투사체 도: The wanted catapult has been modified to fire 3 stones at 0.3 second intervals after first dealing, and inflict damage around the aiming location when the projectile arrives. You can avoid it by moving, and the fired stones will arrive even after the enemy dies.
황제의 은총 가격을 4원으로 변경했습니다. 제국 드론의 중첩당 크기 +0: The price of Emperor's Grace has been changed to 4 won. Empire Drone's size per stack +0.2% and attack range +0.1% only apply at 6 Ursus.
우르수스의 체력 증가량을 중첩당 0.5%로 변경했습니다. 이스티나는 우르: Ursus' health increase has been changed to 0.5% per stack. Istina changes to Ursus/Precision Alliance and gains +2 each normal and +4 each promoted.
크루스·와파린 등이 부여하는 동일한 임시 특질이 한 대상에 중복 적용됩니: The same temporary traits granted by Cruz, Warfarin, etc. are applied multiple times to one target. Each grantor's count limit is calculated independently.
선발 오퍼레이터에게 비콘을 사용할 수 없도록 변경했습니다. 거부 시 비콘: Beacons have been disabled for starter operators. If rejected, the beacon and destination remain.
힐 투사체의 본체와 꼬리를 기존의 25%로 축소했습니다. 이스티나의 맹세: The body and tail of the heal projectile have been reduced to 25% of the original size. Istina's Oath was renamed to Zima's Oath.
The browser update instructions on the connection screen have been changed to Korean.
선발 프리셋을 변경해도 오퍼레이터 설정의 스킬 선택을 유지합니다. 선택하: Even if you change the starting preset, the skill selection in the operator settings will be maintained. The skill and skin settings of unselected starting operators will also be preserved.
전투 종료 버튼을 전투 포기로 변경하고, 기존 색을 유지하면서 준비 완료: Changed the end battle button to abandon battle, and kept the existing colors to match the style of the ready button.
관전·참가 전환에 양방향 2초 쿨타임을 적용했습니다. 버튼과 서버에서 모: A two-way cooldown of 2 seconds has been applied to the transition between spectating and participating. Restrictions both on the button and on the server.
When hiding an Alliance, the entire list is hidden. The expand button is retained.
전투 결과 압축 과정에서 누락되던 물리·마법·고정·원소 피해와 스킬 사용: Additional statistics such as physical, magical, fixed, elemental damage, skill use, and redeployment that were omitted during the battle result compression process are maintained. Stats graphs also display bars when only existing total damage is recorded. Damage that is not classified by type is indicated as damage of unrecorded type, and the height of the bar section is specified.
원본 0.2.3 통합 · 전투 통계 그래프 · 보스 사망 모션: Original 0.2.3 integration · Battle statistics graph · Boss death motion
클레멘티아와 슈·울피아누스 신규 모듈을 추가했습니다. 미출시 오퍼레이터도: New modules for Clementia and Shu·Ulpianus have been added. Unreleased operators are also listed.
글자 크기 4단계, 오퍼레이터별 음성 언어, 홈 화면 설치, 전원 찬성: Added 4 levels of font size, voice language for each operator, home screen installation, all-initiated reroll, and device match recovery.
원본의 스킬 발동·기절·지속 회복·이동 방향·효과음·모델 로딩·AI 수정: The original skill activation, stun, continuous recovery, movement direction, sound effects, model loading, and AI modifications were reflected along with the existing custom rules.
결과 통계에 18개 지표의 팀원·라운드·오퍼레이터별 그래프를 추가했습니다: Graphs for 18 indicators by team member, round, and operator have been added to the result statistics.
보스 처치가 확정되면 남은 표시 HP와 관계없이 사망 애니메이션을 한 번: Once the boss has been defeated, the death animation will play once regardless of the remaining displayed HP.
If there are more than 12 Alliances, 11.5 are displayed and the ends are gradient-processed. You can now drag without a scroll bar, and the hidden button height has been reduced.
이동 공격 적이 선딜 중 멈추는 문제와 도시 맵 장식의 겹친 면을 수정했: Fixed an issue where moving attack enemies would stop while attacking and the overlapping sides of city map decorations.
데이터 재생성 시 스킨 및 한국어·일본어 음성 목록이 누락되는 문제를 수: Fixed an issue where skins and Korean/Japanese voice lists were missing when regenerating data.
Fixed resource downloads to be broken down into shorter tasks and resumed when interrupted. With 4 parallel downloads, you'll continue to receive the rest regardless of the delayed files.
리소스 다운로드 창에 숫자와 진행 막대만 작게 표시하는 접기·펼치기 버튼: Collapse/expand buttons that display only numbers and progress bars in small sizes have been added to the resource download window.
중국어 음성을 제거하고 일본어 음성의 잘못된 다운로드 주소를 수정했습니다: Removed Chinese voices and fixed incorrect download address for Japanese voices. Voices without Korean are replaced with Japanese.
After a store image fails to load, display the image again when the download is complete.
자동 품질 조절이 심한 지연을 감지하고 맵 해상도를 조절하도록 보완했습니: Automatic quality control has been improved to detect severe lag and adjust map resolution.
전투 표시·우르수스 조정·진영 연동 프리셋: Battle display, Ursus adjustment, faction linkage preset
전략 선택 화면의 오퍼레이터 설정 옆에 선발 프리셋 바로가기 버튼을 추가: A shortcut button to starting presets has been added next to operator settings in the strategy selection screen.
선호·선발 프리셋에 진영별 연동을 추가했습니다. 채팅에서 진영을 선택하면: Added faction-specific linkage to preferred/selection presets. When you select a faction in chat, the associated preset is applied, and the selection composition changes only up to the strategy selection stage.
We have improved the deployment of expansion settings and the rebang voting function.
우르수스의 기존 오퍼레이터와 겹치는 헬라그·로사·지마 더 레이징 타이드를: Helag, Rosa, and Zima the Raging Tide, which overlap with Ursus' existing operators, have been excluded from the additional selection list.
3우르수스의 중첩당 최대 HP 증가량을 1%p에서 0.8%p로 변경했습니: 3Ursus' maximum HP increase per stack has been changed from 1%p to 0.8%p.
6우르수스의 제국 드론 공격력 기여 비율을 기본 10% + 중첩당 0.0: 6Ursus' Imperial Drone attack power contribution rate changed to base 10% + 0.015%p per stack.
레토 특질을 일반 +2·승급 +4씩 최대 8회로, 이스티나 특질의 최대: The maximum number of activations for the Leto trait has been changed to 8 (general +2 and promotion +4), and the maximum number of activations for the Istina trait has been changed to 8. When Botani activates his first skill during battle, he gains general +7 and promotion +14.
The purchase price of Emperor's Grace has been changed from 1 won to 5 won.
이스티나의 맹세(우르수스·기습·불굴 중첩 각각 +8, 동료 적용)와 우르: Istina's Oath (+8 stacks of Ursus, Surprise, and Indomitable each, applies to allies) and Ursus Support (1 random Ursus Operator) have been added to the tactical selection.
Changed Sakiko note size from 50% to 65% of default size.
침수구역의 지상 적을 더 낮게 표시하고 은신 안개의 크기를 20% 줄였습: Ground enemies in flooded areas appear lower and the size of the Stealth Fog has been reduced by 20%.
마우스로 오퍼레이터를 드래그할 때 타일 중심으로 달라붙는 효과를 제거했습: Removed the effect of the operator sticking to the center of the tile when dragging it with the mouse.
전투 중 맹약 목록을 가로 스크롤·줄바꿈 없이 한 줄로 표시합니다. 중앙: During battle, the Alliance list is displayed in one line without horizontal scrolling or line breaks. If you press the fold button below the center, it will move up, leaving only the bottom 1/3 as a transparency gradient.
명일방주 이모티콘 탭에 원본 전체 36종을 추가하고 커스텀 36종과 별도: A total of 36 original types were added to the Myeongil Ark emoticon tab, and pages could be turned separately from the 36 custom types.
공격·스킬 범위의 미리보기와 전투 중 표시가 전투 구역 밖으로 나오지 않: Preview of attack/skill range and display during battle have been restricted so that they do not appear outside the battle area.
타수형 적의 HP 보정을 원작 데이터에 맞춰 적용하되 보급선의 HP 증가: HP correction for hit-and-run enemies was applied in line with the original data, but the HP increase for supply ships was excluded.
보스전 화면·공격 모션·우르수스 조정: Boss battle screen, attack motion, and Ursus adjustments
보스전 적 정보 예고 구역의 바닥을 복구하고 상단의 불필요한 일반 전장: Restored the bottom of the boss fight enemy information preview area and removed unnecessary general battlefield geometry from the top.
전용 공격 대기 모션이 있는 오퍼레이터가 연속 공격 사이에 매번 무기를: Fixed an issue where Operators with a dedicated attack idle motion would lower their weapon each time between consecutive attacks.
보타니 특질을 전투 중 첫 스킬 발동 시 활성화된 우르수스 중첩 일반 +: The Botani trait has been changed to Ursus Stacks: Normal +8 and Promotion +16, activated when the first skill is activated during battle. The stack increase upon acquisition has been removed.
Reduced size growth per stack of Imperial Drones to 0.25%.
제국 드론의 공격 범위가 중첩당 0.15% 증가하는 히든 효과를 추가했습: Added a hidden effect that increases the attack range of Imperial Drones by 0.15% per stack.
6우르수스의 공격력 기여 비율 설명을 실제 값인 중첩당 +0.025%p로: 6The description of Ursus' attack power contribution ratio has been modified to the actual value of +0.025%p per stack.
커스텀 확장의 최소 구성 위반을 선택 시점에 차단합니다. 잘못된 프리셋: Block minimal configuration violations of custom extensions at the time of selection. It also blocks incorrect preset loading.
익명 리방 투표를 추가했습니다. 인간 참가자 전원이 동의하면 방과 설정을: Added anonymous rebang voting. Once all human participants agree, they return to the waiting room, retaining their room settings.
The wording of the return to spectating button has been changed to return.
전투 표시·번역·화면 오류 수정: Fixed battle display, translation, and screen errors
보스전 시점 변경 시 대미지·회복 텍스트, 투사체, 조준점과 피격 효과가: Fixed an issue where damage/recovery text, projectiles, aiming points, and hit effects were misaligned on the model when changing the boss battle viewpoint.
Fixed an issue where operators around stationary bosses would be obscured by the boss model.
특성·재능·스킬·모듈 설명의 한국어 번역을 보강하고 중복 문장을 재검사했: We strengthened the Korean translation of attribute, talent, skill, and module descriptions and rechecked duplicate sentences.
Restored chat on simulation completion screen.
리소스 다운로드 실패 안내에서 실패한 파일을 건너뛰고 안내창을 닫을 수: In the resource download failure notification, you can skip the failed file and close the guidance window.
Fixed an error that occurred when opening the statistics page.
시뮬레이션 방식 선택 화면의 패치노트 버튼을 돌아가기·핑 표시 옆으로 옮: The patch notes button on the simulation method selection screen has been moved next to the return/ping indicator.
원본 선발 오퍼레이터를 통합하고 스킬·모듈·스킨·음성을 반영했습니다. 글: The original selection operator was integrated and skills, modules, skins, and voices were reflected. Global unreleased operators are hidden from the settings list.
오퍼레이터별 잠재능력과 육성 단계를 설정할 수 있습니다. 전략 선택 중: You can set the potential and training stage for each operator. Supports changing settings during strategy selection.
비헌터를 3단계·중첩 +5, 우쿠시크를 2단계·중첩 +3으로 변경했습니다: Changed Be-Hunter to level 3 and stacking +5, and Ukusik to level 2 and stacking +3. Changed Botani's Speed ​​Alliance and gain stacks to Miracles.
우르수스 6단계 장비 황제의 은총을 추가했습니다. 우르수스 드론의 기본: Ursus level 6 equipment Emperor’s Grace has been added. Reduces the base size of the Ursus Drone and increases its size by 0.5% per stack.
We have removed redundant information in the descriptions of the modified structure and Ursus song.
Reduced the size of Sakiko's musical note bubble by half.
원본 0.2.2의 밀기·당기기 불균형 상태, 보스전 포탈, 침수 맵 경로: Reflected the original 0.2.2 push/pull imbalance, boss battle portal, flooded map path, and operator rule modifications.
교편 사용 시 현상금 3개 중 하나를 선택합니다. 보스전과 히든 보스전에: When using the teaching tool, choose one of three bounties. If you meet the conditions in boss battles and hidden boss battles, you will receive a tactical training bounty.
삼중합성 시 두루마리로 복제한 장비가 누락되는 문제를 수정했습니다. 상점: Fixed an issue where equipment duplicated with a scroll would be missing during triple synthesis. The slots opened by store promotions will be filled at the next update.
상단 전투 진행도는 본 웨이브 적의 처치와 유출을 함께 계산합니다. 소환: The combat progress at the top is calculated together with kills and drains of enemies in the main wave. Summoned and split enemies are excluded from progress.
정수 프레임의 공격 간격·선딜·SP 충전이 한 프레임 늦어지는 문제를 수: Fixed an issue where the attack interval, first damage, and SP recharge of integer frames were delayed by one frame.
데이터 통합에서 누락된 공격 애니메이션 타이밍을 서버와 브라우저 전투에: Restored missing attack animation timings in data integration to server and browser battles.
기기에 저장되는 대전 통계와 기록, 진단 정보 복사, AI 팀원 마지막: Added options to save match statistics and records on the device, copy diagnostic information, and select AI teammate last time.
탄약·늑대 그림자·집착 피해 표시와 적 애니메이션을 보완했습니다. 준비: Ammunition, Wolf Shadow, and Obsession damage display and enemy animations have been improved. Automatically collapses your store when ready.
음성 언어 적용과 누락 파일 대체 재생을 수정하고 한국어·일본어 음성 및: We fixed the application of audio language and replacement playback of missing files, and updated the list of Korean and Japanese voices and skins.
패치노트 버전 목록을 한 줄 가로 스크롤로 변경하고 본문을 창 내부에서: Changed the patch note version list to scroll horizontally in one line and modified the text to scroll inside the window.
Personal renewal frequency settings have been reflected.
밴 목록·전략 선택 단계의 채팅, 대기실 하단 배치와 번역 누락을 수정했: Fixed chat, waiting room bottom placement, and missing translations in the ban list/strategy selection stage.
중복 단축키 처리와 준비·휴식 관전에서 차단 공사가 사라지는 문제를 수정: Fixed an issue where blocked construction would disappear during duplicate shortcut handling and preparation/rest spectating.
리소스 다운로드 재시도·실패 원인 표시를 추가하고 패치 간 캐시 중복 저: Added resource download retry/failure cause display and reduced cache redundancy between patches.
직접 치료를 받을 수 없는 오퍼레이터와 소환물의 회복 판정을 수정했습니다: Fixed recovery rolls for Operators and summons that cannot receive direct healing. Continuous recovery applies as normal.
위셔델 소환 수와 배치 위치를 수정하고 레버넌트의 그림자 번역을 반영했습: Changed the number of Wishadell summons and placement locations and reflected Revenant's Shadow translation.
위셔델 2스킬 과부하의 4회 타격과 다단 공격의 타격별 장비 효과를 수정: The equipment effects for each hit of Wisherdel 2 skill Overload's 4-hit and multi-step attacks have been corrected.
Reflects the 2 consecutive hits of non-hunter basic attacks.
우르수스 드론의 조준 취소 후 공격 대기를 수정하고 보스 우선 대상에서: Modified the attack wait after canceling the aim of the Ursus Drone and excluded wanted bosses from the boss priority list.
선발 오퍼레이터 표시 오류로 기물 위치와 배치·승급 효과가 남는 문제를: Fixed an issue where the item location and placement/promotion effects were left behind due to an error in the selection operator display.
The update of piece position and drag status during rest periods and when switching between spectators has been corrected.
공중 유닛이 고지대를 지나갈 때 비행 높이가 달라지는 문제를 수정했습니다: Fixed an issue where air units would have different flight heights when passing over high ground.
Fixed an issue where the fixed boss model and HP bar were biased to one side.
The remaining shield health on the HP bar is displayed in white.
The creation location of the damage text has been moved up slightly.
Fixed an issue where map preview images were missing when deployed.
전략 선택 중 선발 변경 시 오래된 설정으로 오류가 발생하는 문제와 좁은: Fixed an issue where an error occurred due to outdated settings when changing selection during strategy selection, and the arrangement of operator settings on a narrow screen has been fixed.
가상적: 총의 연속 공격 속도 보너스와 침수 맵 보스의 이동 경로를 수정: Virtual Enemies: Fixed the gun's continuous attack speed bonus and the movement path of the Flooded map boss.
Shows remaining ammo and ammo compartments in the operator information window.
It has been modified to be placed in order from top to bottom starting from the left column at the start of battle.
We have increased the attack/bombing range of imperial drones and the visibility of stealth fog.
Slightly increased the duration of the red indicator when hit.
It reflects the operator's full potential abilities and talents.
Deployment location and relocation processing during surprise attack, return, and resurrection have been modified.
The reduction of charge SP in the necrotic state and the handling of enemy cold and freeze have been corrected.
죄수의 해방, 타격 횟수형 적과 보스 소환물의 라운드 보정을 수정했습니다: Fixed round compensation for Prisoner's Liberation, hit count enemies, and boss summons.
HP 회복·연쇄 치유·차지 캐스터와 일부 오퍼레이터·소환물의 동작을 수정: The behavior of HP recovery, chain healing, charge casters, and some operators and summons has been modified.
Mudlock 3 skill has been modified to be disabled in closed mode.
The bard has been modified to maintain attribute recovery even when stunned, frozen, or sleeping.
Texas skill 2's hit delay and 2nd hit animation have been corrected.
Added charging animation and energy accumulation display for Mystic Caster.
포트리스의 저지 대상 공격을 근접 단일 공격으로 수정하고 전용 모션을 연: The Fortress' blocking target attack has been modified to be a single melee attack and a dedicated motion has been linked to it.
When giving consumables to an Operator whose equipment is full, you select which equipment to replace.
Fixed an issue where promotion reward titles would increase store height.
Added operator/equipment preference presets and store star indicators.
Separated the preferred presets list and added Alliance/tier filters.
Store favorites are distinguished by a light blue luminous border, while starters are distinguished by a mint green border.
The store's star and selection signs have been placed at the same height as the rating and price badges.
선호 목록에서 선발 오퍼레이터를 제외하고 대기실 채팅의 표시 순서를 수정: Fixed the display order of lobby chat by removing the starting operator from the favorites list.
선호 프리셋과 확장 설정의 목록·필터·카드 배치를 정리하고, 구성 화면의: We have organized the list, filter, and card arrangement of preferred presets and extended settings, and moved the preferred button on the configuration screen to the side of the tab.
커스텀 확장 프리셋과 분류별 아이콘·미리보기를 추가했습니다. 맵에 등장: Added custom expansion presets and category-specific icons and previews. Displays the difficulty level on the map.
The spectating target selection during the boss battle break period is displayed when the store is closed.
커스텀 확장에서 핵심 맹약·맵·보스·전략을 금지할 수 있습니다. 게임에: You can ban key Alliances, maps, bosses, and strategies in custom expansions. Maintain the minimum configuration required for the game.
During battle, an Alliance stack notification will be displayed above the operator who activated the effect.
Changed starting composition during strategy selection to be applied before confirming the strategy.
The handling of open store slots, standby seats, and temporary standby seats when upgrading has been modified.
Processing when start and stop requests overlap during battle data loading has been modified.
전투 효과·스킬·관전 개선: Improved combat effects, skills, and spectating
Sakiko's notes are displayed as traceable bubbles.
무기별 투사체·근접 타격·피격 효과를 개선하고 어울리지 않는 공통 입자를: We have improved the projectile, melee, and hit effects for each weapon and reduced common particles that do not match.
Restored melee weapon afterimages and changed them to a semi-transparent tapered shape.
The wide attack effect has been adjusted to the actual attack/skill range.
Exclusive hitting effects for Texas skill 2 Gumby and 6 Cashmere have been added.
Zima's 3rd skill has been modified to have a fixed strike and continuous motion unrelated to attack speed.
Adjusted the speed of Salkaz Lancer's excessive movement motion.
