The range expansion skill has been modified to activate on enemies outside the basic attack range.
The skill range colors have been changed to be more vivid and the map shadows have been strengthened.
Damage text has been changed to display at the same height rather than being stacked on top.
The skin of the spectator stand and the location of the boss battle stand have been modified.
전략 선택 중에도 오퍼레이터의 스킬·모듈·스킨과 선발 설정을 변경할 수: Even while selecting a strategy, you can change the operator's skills, modules, skins, and selection settings.
The playback timing of attack and hit sounds has been restored to the previous method.
음량 변경 시 음성 언어가 초기화되는 문제를 수정하고 언어 변경 시 이전: Fixed an issue where the audio language would be reset when changing the volume, and the previous audio would be interrupted when changing the language.
한국어 음성 파일의 실제 제공 여부를 확인해 없는 대사만 일본어로 대체합: We check whether the Korean voice file is actually available and replace missing lines with Japanese.
기본 채팅 알림음을 이모티콘 효과음으로 변경했습니다. 알림음 선택과 끄기: The default chat notification sound has been changed to an emoticon sound effect. The notification sound selection and off settings are maintained.
전투 오류 수정과 화면 개선: Combat error corrections and screen improvements
Fixed missing shooting platforms, water platforms, and sealed floors in the original 3D map.
비활성 전장의 수면·타일 잔여 표시와 보이지 않는 타일의 클릭 판정을 수: Fixed display of water/tile remaining on inactive battlefields and click judgment on invisible tiles.
Changed Hellag's trait to increased attack speed and added Indomitable Alliance.
압생트를 비헌터로 교체했습니다. 우르수스·기습 중첩 획득과 약점 대미지: Absinthe was replaced with Bee Hunter. Ursus: Apply surprise stack acquisition and weak point damage traits, and the basic skill is 2 skills.
제국 드론은 기지에 가장 가까운 적을 우선하며, 지마 3스킬은 적이 없어: Imperial drones give priority to enemies closest to the base, and Zima's 3 skill fires even if there are no enemies.
스카디 더 커럽팅 하트의 스킬 판정과 해사 처치 후 재배치를 수정했습니다: Fixed Skadi the Corrupting Heart's skill roll and relocation after killing the Marine.
과열 스킬의 절반 구간·빨간색 바와 충전형 스킬의 시전시간 표시·시전 중: The half section of the overheating skill, the red bar and the display of the casting time of the rechargeable skill, and SP recovery during casting have been modified.
Reduced Loop Shooter Boomerang size and improved projectile body visibility.
Enemy movement animation speed adjusted to current movement speed multiplier.
공중 유닛의 등장 높이와 높은 타일을 지날 때의 높이 처리를 수정했습니다: Fixed the spawn height of air units and the height handling when crossing high tiles.
은신 모델을 더 어둡게 표시하고 범위 그림자를 강화했습니다. 스킬 범위: Stealth models appear darker and area shadows have been strengthened. Changed the skill range dotted line to move and removed the overlap position correction.
The deployment-type skill activation of surprise relocation and the surprise attack immediately after relocation have been modified.
와일드메인 2스킬·첸 더 던스트릭 3스킬·아스트젠 3스킬 등 범위 확장: The automatic activation judgment of range expansion skills such as Wildmain skill 2, Chen the Dunstreak skill 3, and Astgen skill 3 has been corrected.
We have moved the guidance message to the bottom of the Alliance list and enlarged the display of activation levels.
배치 인원이 없는 맹약을 숨기고 10개를 넘는 목록은 가로 스크롤로 표시: Alliances without assigned personnel are hidden and lists of more than 10 are displayed with horizontal scrolling.
I changed it to release focus after clicking the button.
커스텀 확장 선택을 저장해 새 방에 적용하고 설정 버튼을 오퍼레이터 설정: I saved the custom extension selection and applied it to the new room, placed the Settings button below the Operator Settings, and adjusted the height of the Start button.
An issue where equipment and objects in the spectator area were displayed in duplicate has been corrected.
Added Korean translation of invitation link text and some screens.
동일한 피해 이벤트의 숫자 중복 표시를 방지하고 좌우 이동 폭을 줄였습니: Prevented the display of duplicate numbers for the same damage event and reduced the width of left and right movement.
리소스 백그라운드 다운로드와 진행 안내를 지원합니다. 기존 캐시는 재사용: Supports background downloading of resources and progress guidance. Existing cache is reused.
Displays the base map before downloading the original map.
Fixed desert tile lighting and display of inactive battlefield structures.
3명: 제국 드론·우르수스 오퍼레이터 공격력·HP +20%, 중첩당 +1: 3 people: Imperial Drone·Ursus Operator Attack Power·HP +20%, +1%p per stacks.
6명: 제국 드론 공격속도 +50%, 범위 내 은신 무효화. 배치된 우르: 6 people: Imperial drone attack speed +50%, stealth within range is nullified. Acquires 5% of the total attack power of the deployed Ursus Operator as basic attack power, with a rate of +0.025%p per stacks.
로사 6단계·지마 5단계. 로사 특질 공격력 증가 1%p, 지마 기본 3: Rosa stage 6, Zima stage 5. Rosa's trait attack power increase by 1%p, Zima's basic 3 skills, trait +6/elite +12.
Helag's trait has been changed to increase attack speed.
이스티나 특질 +2/+1·최대 10회, 레토 +3·최대 7회로 조정했습니: Istina trait has been adjusted to +2/+1, up to 10 times, and Leto +3, up to 7 times.
The hit timing and end processing of attack/skill motions have been modified.
벤델라·리드 더 플레임 섀도우 등 일부 스킬의 일반 공격 모션과 타격 시: The normal attack motion and hitting timing of some skills such as Vendela and Lead the Flame Shadow have been modified.
The timing of the effect occurrence of activated skills such as Pinecone 1 skill has been corrected.
Fixed the armor roll for Sarkaz Lancer's extra charge damage.
Fixed death animation and air unit rendering while freezing.
Changpan · Thorns the Lodestar 2 skill · skill range display has been modified.
Added glow and light shadow to the skill range outline.
The spectator camera has been adjusted to a store folded angle.
Supports switching of teammate perspectives on the same battlefield during the boss battle break period.
Enlarged the store collapse button and added it to the left of freeze.
HP·SP바 스타일을 조정하고 오퍼레이터 정보창에 실시간 SP바를 추가했: The HP/SP bar style has been adjusted and a real-time SP bar has been added to the operator information window.
The collapse button and duplicate spectator symbols in the Alliance list have been removed.
This edition's information displays a list of bans for each Alliance and the current target's strategy.
The handling of closing information windows when externally manipulated and closing sub-information windows has been modified.
Fixed list display and deployment button translation for unselected draft operators.
Chat notification sound and notification sound settings have been added.
Damage display is divided into no display, total, all, and basic.
페페 무료 새로고침, 비질 소환, 울피아누스 복귀, 공중 우선 공격과 관: Fixed Pepe free refresh, Vigil summon, Ulpianus return, air priority attack and spectator round instructions.
커스텀 확장 설정에 맹약·전장 탭을 추가했습니다. 여러 확장을 함께 선택: The Alliance/Battlefield tab has been added to custom expansion settings. You can select multiple extensions together and the button displays the number of applications.
우르수스 제국 드론의 공격력·HP 기본 보너스를 50%, 중첩당 증가를: The basic attack power and HP bonus of the Ursus Empire drone has been adjusted to 50%, and the increase per stack has been adjusted to 2.5%p. Added +50% movement speed and disabling stealth within the effect range for 6 people.
제국 드론의 이동·조준·대상 전환을 개선하고 공격속도를 폭격 지연에도 적: Imperium drone movement, aiming, and target switching have been improved, and attack speed has also been applied to bombing delay. Kashay's level-up cost reduction has been adjusted to 4.
정예 우쿠시크·이스티나·보타니의 특질 증가량을 각각 +8·+4·+12로: The trait increase amount of elite Ukushik, Istina, and Botani has been modified to +8, +4, and +12, respectively. Zima applies +8 and elite +16 when entering and ending the rest period, respectively.
전투 시작 시 휴식 기간에 배치한 순서대로 오퍼레이터를 배치합니다. 전장: At the start of combat, deploy your Operators in the order they were deployed during the rest period. Movement, exchange of positions, or change of direction within the battlefield do not affect the order.
솔로 보스·히든 보스의 HP 0.25배 보정을 제거했습니다. 협동은 기본: The 0.25x HP correction for Solo Boss and Hidden Boss has been removed. Co-op multiplies base HP by the number of surviving participants at the start of the boss fight.
스킬 범위를 대표 색상과 굵은 점선으로 표시하고 겹침·높이 문제를 개선했: The skill range is displayed with representative colors and thick dotted lines, and overlap and height issues have been improved. Attack/skill animations and projectile/melee effects have been improved.
보스전과 히든 보스전을 1배속으로 진행합니다. 휴식 기간 애니메이션은 1: Boss battles and hidden boss battles proceed at 1x speed. Rest period animations play at 1x speed and the waiting area is hidden during combat.
일부 적의 누락된 특성을 보완하고 빙결·굴절·보호막 등 상태 효과의 시인: We have supplemented the missing characteristics of some enemies and improved the visibility of status effects such as freeze, refraction, and shield.
관전 및 다른 플레이어 전장 확인 시 대기석·보스·스킨·체력 표시를 보완: When spectating or checking other players' battlefields, the waiting area, boss, skin, and health display have been improved.
When entering a cooperative operation, Aegir's predation results and used resurrection information are maintained.
라플란드 승급 후 첫 새로고침 특질이 발동하도록 수정했습니다. 키아베가: Lapland has been modified to activate the Refresh trait for the first time after promotion. Operators paid by Kiabe during a refresh will apply the trait from the next refresh.
Maintains scroll position even when new messages arrive while reading previous chats.
채팅 버튼으로 창을 열 때 입력칸에 자동으로 포커스를 주지 않습니다. P: When opening a window with the chat button, focus is not automatically given to the input box. The PC's Enter open/input function is maintained.
Portraits, trait duplicates, and Korean descriptions have been supplemented.
메인 화면·로비·대기실에 패치노트 버튼과 버전별 변경 내역을 추가했습니다: A patch note button and change details for each version have been added to the main screen, lobby, and waiting room. The patch notes will be automatically displayed once when you first enter the lobby after the update.
설정 보존과 전투 오류 수정: Preserve settings and fix combat errors
Ursus has been modified to maintain existing skill and skin settings even when turned off and started.
우르수스를 비활성화하면 관련 맹약·추가 오퍼레이터를 게임 정보에서 제외하: If Ursus is disabled, related Alliances and additional operators will be excluded from the game information, and only the existing Alliances of Gum and Betochki will be displayed.
커스텀 진영 활성화 시 핵심 맹약 밴 수를 늘려 사용 가능한 핵심 맹약이: When activating a custom faction, the number of core Alliance bans has been increased so that there are 5 core Alliances available.
Fixed duplication and translation of Ursus-related ban decisions and trait descriptions.
The effects of Aegir and Harmony Alliance have been supplemented to be calculated after sequential placement is completed.
제국 드론의 이동 중 공격과 치유 대상 제외, 염국 소환 용의 발동·공격: The Imperial Drone is excluded from attack and healing targets while moving, and the activation/attack processing of the Flame Nation summoned dragon has been modified.
Fixed an issue where some bosses would bombard all at once at the start of battle.
It has been improved to maintain non-target bombing that has already started even if the target disappears.
은신 상태의 광역 피해 판정을 보완하고 오퍼레이터 특질 설명을 정리했습니: We have improved the area-of-effect damage judgment in stealth mode and organized the operator trait description.
관전 대상 유지와 준비 시간 보스·대기석 표시, 채팅 숨김 기능을 보완했: We have improved the functions for maintaining spectating targets, displaying boss and waiting tables during preparation time, and hiding chat.
우르수스 커스텀 맹약과 오퍼레이터 8명, 제국 드론, 전용 장비와 카셰이: Added Ursus Custom Alliance, 8 Operators, Imperial Drone, exclusive equipment, and Kashay Strategy. Gum and Betochiki are also included in Ursus.
선발 오퍼레이터 선택 기능을 추가했습니다. 5·6단계별 최대 2명을 선택: Added starting operator selection function. You can select up to two operators per level 5 or 6, and only the selected operators will appear in the game.
스킬·모듈 구현을 보완하고 오퍼레이터 구성에서 스킨 선택과 특질 정보를: It complements skill/module implementation and supports skin selection and trait information in operator configuration.
Korean and Japanese operator voices and voice settings have been added.
대기실·전투·결과 화면 채팅과 이모티콘, 진영 선택을 추가했습니다. 관전: Added waiting room, battle, and results screen chat, emoticons, and faction selection. Spectators can join the chat with a gray spectator indicator.
We unified the settings button and screen style and supplemented the Korean translation.
Added the ability to select equipment to replace when equipment slots are full.
공격 타격 시점, 배치·스킬 애니메이션, 방향 전환과 강제 이동 처리를: Attack strike timing, deployment/skill animation, direction change, and forced movement processing have been improved.
공식 전장 모델·스킬 효과음·배경음악·음성·스킨 리소스를 추가하고 브라우: Official battlefield models, skill sound effects, background music, voices, and skin resources are added, and browser cache and missing resource downloads are supported.
docs/PLUGIN-DSL.md#1-一份规格长什么样: docs/PLUGIN-DSL.md#1-What does a specification look like?
插件文件已被其他编辑器修改: The plug-in file has been modified by another editor
重新读取插件，再保存你的修改。: Reload the plugin and save your changes.
等当前对战完成后再试。: Wait until the current match is completed and try again.
这次对战超过了试验台的时间上限: This battle exceeded the time limit of the test bed
缩短场景时长，减少单位或检查插件效果。: Shorten scene duration, reduce units or check plug-in effects.
试验台子进程未能完成对战: Test bed subprocess failed to complete the match
重新检查插件；如果仍失败，请查看服务器日志。: Recheck the plugin; if it still fails, check the server logs.
这次对战的回放超过了大小上限: The replay of this battle exceeds the size limit
缩短对战时长或减少单位和特效。: Shorten the duration of the battle or reduce units and special effects.
检查场景字段、合法部署位置、所属干员与波次；不支持的字段不能运行。: Check the scene fields, legal deployment locations, operators and waves; unsupported fields cannot be run.
这个试验场景不能运行: This test scenario cannot be run
选择有效的干员、波次和 1–120 秒时长；界面插件用沙箱预览。: Select valid operators, waves, and duration of 1–120 seconds; interface plugins are previewed with a sandbox.
每个在座玩家须亲自确认当前内容组合的风险提示。: Each player present must personally confirm the risk warning of the current content combination.
改为监听本机或局域网；确认风险后可显式使用 trusted-force。: Monitor the local machine or LAN instead; use trusted-force explicitly after confirming the risk.
插件锁文件无效、文件已改变或受信任哈希不符: The plugin lock file is invalid, the file has changed, or the trusted hash does not match
重新打包以校验文件；受信任模式还需审核并在 plugins/config.jso: Repackage to verify files; trusted mode also requires auditing and pinning the lock file SHA-256 in trusted in plugins/config.json.
脚本隔离执行可设置 SP_PLUGIN_SCRIPTS=sandbox；受信任代: For script isolation execution, SP_PLUGIN_SCRIPTS=sandbox can be set; trusted code needs to be set to trusted and audited and pinned to the lock hash.
入口只导入 sp:sdk@1；导出同步 setup(sp)，使用 SDK 和确定: The entry only imports sp:sdk@1; exports synchronous setup(sp), using SDK and deterministic assistant.
在清单 overrides 中列出要替换的官方 kit id。: List the official kit ids to be replaced in the overrides manifest.
关闭其中一个插件，或让作者改用不同的 id。: Turn off one of the plugins, or ask the author to use a different id instead.
插件模拟长时间无响应: Plug-in simulation is unresponsive for a long time
检查插件循环并降低每批模拟的负载: Check plugin loops and reduce load for each batch of simulations
查看日志并修复插件: Check the logs and fix the plugin
安装依赖并检查 SDK 接口: Install dependencies and check SDK interface
服务器未开启脚本沙箱: The script sandbox is not enabled on the server
此插件类别不能进入脚本沙箱: This plugin category cannot enter the script sandbox
仅将 script 类插件交给沙箱: Only give script class plugins to the sandbox
脚本文件与内容哈希不符: Script file does not match content hash
重新应用插件并校验文件: Reapply the plugin and verify the file
只导入 sp:sdk@1 和插件内相对路径，避免循环导入: Only import sp:sdk@1 and relative paths within the plug-in to avoid circular imports
脚本使用了不支持的模块语法: The script uses unsupported module syntax
使用同步 setup 和静态导入，参见脚本文档: Use synchronous setup and static import, see script documentation
缩减文件数量和代码体积: Reduce the number of files and code size
脚本数学运算超出确定性范围: Script math operation outside deterministic range
只用有限数字，幂指数必须是整数: Only use finite numbers, the exponents must be integers
本服务器没有安装这个插件: This plug-in is not installed on this server
把插件文件夹放进服务器的 plugins/ 文件夹（文件夹名就是插件 id）；它: Put the plug-in folder into the server's plugins/ folder (the folder name is the plug-in id); if it is no longer there, turn it off in the plug-in panel.
Put the plugin folder into the server\\': Put the plugin folder into the server\'s plugins/ folder (the folder name is the plugin id); if it is gone, switch it off in the plugin panel.
这个插件不能在这里启用：这个版本不应用它的类别，或者它的作用范围不包括这里: This plugin cannot be enabled here: this version does not apply its category, or its scope does not include here
外观插件的 class 写 \"cosmetic\"；scope 写 [\"ro: The class of the appearance plug-in is written as "cosmetic"; the scope is written as ["room"] (the homeowner opens it for the entire room) or ["personal"] (the player only opens it for himself). If you need both, write both.
缺少这个插件需要的其他插件（或者版本不对），或者几个插件的加载顺序互相指向、成了: Other plug-ins required by this plug-in are missing (or the version is wrong), or the loading order of several plug-ins points to each other and forms a circle.
安装 requires 里写的插件（版本要在写的范围内）；或者删掉 loadAf: Install the plug-in written in requires (the version must be within the written range); or delete the items in loadAfter / loadBefore that point to each other.
选中的插件互相冲突，不能一起用: The selected plug-ins conflict with each other and cannot be used together.
关掉其中一个；插件的 conflicts 写着它和谁不能一起用。: Turn off one of them; the conflicts of the plugin say who it cannot be used with.
两个插件把同一个规则开关设成了不同的选项（{path}）: Two plug-ins set the same rule switch to different options ({path})
只保留其中一个插件，或让它们选择同一个选项。: Keep just one of the plugins, or have them all select the same option.
清单里的 rules 写错了：开关或选项不在规定的四种里，或者这个类别的插件不能: The rules in the list are written incorrectly: the switch or option is not among the four specified, or the plug-in of this category cannot declare rules.
rules 只能写 shopBias、prepLoadout、morphPair: rules can only write shopBias, prepLoadout, morphPairing, and unequip, each with the two specified options; only content, script, and trusted can be written.
超出了本服务器的上限：{detail}: Exceeded the upper limit of this server: {detail}
少开几个插件，或者让插件小一点（压缩图片和声音、删掉没用到的文件、少用整条引用）: Open fewer plug-ins, or make plug-ins smaller (compress images and sounds, delete unused files, use fewer whole quotes).
这个玩法插件不适配本服务器的游戏版本（或插件接口版本）: This gameplay plug-in is not suitable for the game version (or plug-in interface version) of this server
换一个适配本版本的插件版本（清单的 \"app\" 写着它适配的游戏版本），或者: Change to a plug-in version that is compatible with this version (the "app" in the list indicates the game version it is compatible with), or ask the author to update it.
本服务器同时运行的插件组合已达上限: The combination of plug-ins running on this server at the same time has reached the upper limit.
稍后再试，或者和正在用插件的房间选同样的插件；服主可以在 plugins/con: Try again later, or select the same plug-in as the room that is using the plug-in; the server owner can increase maxSets in plugins/config.json.
插件文件夹里没有 plugin.json: There is no plugin.json in the plugin folder
每个插件文件夹都要有一个 plugin.json（插件的清单）。在工作台点「新建: Each plugin folder must have a plugin.json (the plugin's manifest). Click "New Plug-in" on the workbench, or run node tools/plugin.mjs new, and one will be generated. The old pack.json is used for language packs in the packs/ folder.
Every plugin folder needs a plugin.json: Every plugin folder needs a plugin.json (its manifest). The studio\'s new plugin or node tools/plugin.mjs new writes one. The older pack.json belongs to a language pack in packs/.
{where} 读不出来：它不是有效的 JSON，或者太大: {where} cannot be read: it is not valid JSON or is too large
检查有没有多写或少写逗号、引号、括号（最后一项后面不能有逗号）；单个 JSON: Check whether there are too many or too few commas, quotation marks, or parentheses (no commas after the last item); a single JSON file cannot exceed 8 MB. Editing with Workbench avoids handwriting errors.
{where} 超出了 JSON 的限制（嵌套太深，或数字太大）: {where} exceeds JSON limit (nesting too deep, or number too large)
嵌套不要超过 64 层，数字要是正常的有限数字，绝对值不超过 10 亿。: The nesting level should not exceed 64 levels, the number should be a normal finite number, and the absolute value should not exceed 1 billion.
plugin.json 的最外层不是 { … } 对象: The outermost layer of plugin.json is not a { … } object
整个文件要用一对大括号 { } 包起来，里面写 \"名字\": 值。: The entire file should be wrapped in a pair of curly brackets { }, with "name": value written inside.
缺少 \"manifest\": 2，或者写成了别的数: "manifest": 2 is missing, or written as another number
在 plugin.json 里写上 \"manifest\": 2（这是清单格式: Write "manifest": 2 in plugin.json (this is the manifest format version, now it can only be 2).
文件夹名「{id}」不能当插件 id: The folder name "{id}" cannot be used as the plug-in ID
插件 id 就是文件夹名：2–32 个小写英文字母、数字或 -，不能以 - 开头: The plug-in id is the folder name: 2–32 lowercase English letters, numbers, or -, and cannot start with - (for example, texas-red). Just rename the folder.
清单里写的 \"id\" 和文件夹名「{id}」不一样，以文件夹名为准: The "id" written in the list is different from the folder name "{id}". The folder name shall prevail.
删掉清单里的 \"id\"（文件夹名就是 id），或者把它改得和文件夹名一样。: Delete "id" in the list (the folder name is the id), or change it to be the same as the folder name.
「{where}」不是清单里的字段，被忽略了: "{where}" is not a field in the list and is ignored.
检查拼写（大小写也要一样），或者删掉它。: Check the spelling (capitalization should be the same), or delete it.
没有写插件类别 \"class\"，或者写了不认识的类别: The plug-in category "class" is not written, or an unknown category is written.
外观插件写 \"class\": \"cosmetic\"。可选的类别：lang: For the appearance plug-in, write "class": "cosmetic". Optional categories: lang (language), cosmetic (appearance), content (data), script, ui, trusted.
用 zh、en、ja、ko、zh-TW 这样的语言代码。: Use language codes such as zh, en, ja, ko, zh-TW.
插件的版本号 \"version\" 没写，或者写法不对: The plug-in version number "version" is not written, or it is written incorrectly.
Write it as a three-segment number, such as "1.0.0"; every time you change the plug-in, increase it a little bit (1.0.1, 1.1.0...).
适配的游戏版本 \"app\" 没写，或者写法不对: The adapted game version "app" is not written, or it is written incorrectly.
写成一个版本范围，例如 \">=0.3.0 <0.4.0\"（本游戏现在是 {a: Written as a version range, for example ">=0.3.0 <0.4.0" (this game is now {app}).
这个插件是给游戏 {range} 做的，本服务器是 {app}: This plug-in is for the game {range}, this server is {app}
外观插件照样能用（只是提醒）。在新版本里确认没问题后，把 \"app\" 改成包: The appearance plug-in still works (just a reminder). After confirming that there is no problem in the new version, change "app" to a range that includes {app}.
插件接口级别 \"api\" 没写、不是整数，或者本游戏不支持: The plug-in interface level "api" is not written, is not an integer, or is not supported by this game.
外观插件写 [\"room\", \"personal\"]：room 是房主给: The appearance plug-in is written as ["room", "personal"]: room is opened by the homeowner for the entire room, and personal is opened by the player only for himself in the settings.
A cosmetic plugin has [\"room\", \"perso: A cosmetic plugin has ["room", "personal"]: room — the host switches it on for the whole room; personal — a player for themselves in settings.
主页 \"homepage\" 不是 http(s) 网址，被忽略了: Home page "homepage" is not an http(s) URL and is ignored
写完整的网址，例如 https://example.com/my-plugin，: Write the complete URL, such as https://example.com/my-plugin, or delete it.
写成 { \"其他插件的 id\": \"版本范围\" }，例如 { \"bas: Write { "other plugin ID": "version range" }, for example { "base-skin": ">=1.0.0" }; you cannot write yourself, and the same plug-in cannot be both required and conflicting, up to 32.
加载顺序（loadAfter / loadBefore / priority）写: The loading order (loadAfter/loadBefore/priority) is written incorrectly: {where}
loadAfter 和 loadBefore 是插件 id 的列表（同一个 id: loadAfter and loadBefore are lists of plug-in IDs (the same ID cannot be written on both sides, nor can it write itself); priority is an integer from -1000 to 1000, and the default is 0.
设置项 \"settings\" 写得不对：{where}: The setting item "settings" is written incorrectly: {where}
每个设置项写 { \"type\": … }：boolean（开关）、integ: Write { "type": … } for each setting item: boolean (switch), integer/number (min and max should be written), enum (options list should be written); the default value must be within the range; the maximum is 32, and cannot be free text.
设置项里有不认识的字段「{where}」，被忽略了: There is an unknown field "{where}" in the setting item and it is ignored.
设置项只认 type、default、min、max、step、options、: The setting items only recognize the fields type, default, min, max, step, options, and label.
「{where}」不是 {class} 插件能带的东西: "{where}" is not something that the {class} plug-in can bring
外观插件只带 \"assets\"（素材）和 \"theme\"（主题）；界面插: The appearance plug-in only has "assets" (materials) and "theme" (theme); the interface plug-in has "entry.client" and "slots"; changing values, adding operators, etc. must be made into content plug-ins.
写成插件文件夹里的一个 .json 文件路径（或这些路径的列表）；\"asset: Written as a .json file path (or a list of these paths) in the plugin folder; "assets" and "theme" can also be written directly as { … } objects.
素材「{where}」写的文件不对：不是插件文件夹里的路径，或者不是这个位置要的: The file written by material "{where}" is wrong: it is not the path in the plug-in folder, or it is not the file type required at this location.
写插件文件夹里的相对路径，例如 art/avatar.png。图片位置用 .pn: Write the relative path to the plugin folder, for example art/avatar.png. Use .png .jpg .webp for picture position, .mp3 .ogg for sound position, and .skel and .atlas (texture .png) for models.
主题「{where}」里写了网址: The URL is written in the topic "{where}"
主题变量只能写颜色、时间或缓动，不能写网址、var() 或其他表达式。: Theme variables can only write color, time or easing, not URL, var() or other expressions.
这条提示来自旧版本：这一版会在玩家自己的画面上应用主题变量: This tip is from an older version: This version applies theme variables to the player's own screen
这一版不再发出这条提示。主题变量写在 theme.vars 里，只能用本安装的设: This prompt will no longer be issued in this version. Theme variables are written in theme.vars, and only the design variables of this installation can be used.
主题变量「{where}」不是本安装的设计变量: Theme variable "{where}" is not a design variable for this installation
只能设置 public/css/theme.css 里 :root 的颜色、时间: Only the color, time and easing variables of :root in public/css/theme.css can be set, such as --text-hi, --t-fast, --ease-out.
主题变量「{where}」的值不是这种变量允许的颜色、时间或缓动: The value of theme variable '{where}' is not a color, time or easing allowed for this variable
颜色用 #rgb、#rgba、#rrggbb、#rrggbbaa 或 rgb(): Use #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() for color; use 0–2000ms or 0–2s for time; use keywords or cubic-bezier() for easing. You cannot write URLs, quotes or expressions.
一个插件最多写 64 个主题变量。: A plugin can write up to 64 theme variables.
主题「{where}」不是变量表: Topic "{where}" is not a variable table
写成 \"theme\": { \"vars\": { \"--text-hi\: Written as "theme": { "vars": { "--text-hi": "#f4faf7" } }. Flat objects whose keys all start with -- will also work.
notices 是列表，每条有 id（小写字母、数字和 -）、title、bod: notices is a list, each item has an id (lowercase letters, numbers and -), title, body, and can have date (YYYY-MM-DD) and i18n.
公告超过了条数或字数上限: The announcement exceeds the maximum number of articles or characters.
一个插件最多 20 条公告，标题最多 80 字，正文最多 2000 字。: A plug-in can have a maximum of 20 announcements, a maximum of 80 words in the title, and a maximum of 2,000 words in the text.
公告「{where}」的标题或正文不是纯文本，或是空的: The title or body of the announcement "{where}" is not plain text or is empty.
标题和正文都要有字。正文可以换行。不要写控制字符。链接就当普通文字写。: Both the title and body text must have words. Text can be wrapped. Do not write control characters. Just write the link as normal text.
公告「{where}」的语言代码不认识: Announcement "{where}" language code is not recognized
i18n 的键用本游戏认识的语言代码，例如 en、ja、ko、zh-TW。: i18n keys use language codes recognized by this game, such as en, ja, ko, zh-TW.
入口 \"entry\" 写得不对，或者这个类别不能有入口：{where}: The entry "entry" is written incorrectly, or this category cannot have an entry: {where}
外观插件不需要 \"entry\"，删掉它。界面插件写 \"entry\": {: Appearance plugins don't need "entry", delete it. For the interface plug-in, write "entry": { "client": "ui/index.html" } (a .html file in the plug-in folder).
「{where}」只属于语言包（lang 类），{class} 插件不能写: "{where}" only belongs to the language package (lang class), and the {class} plug-in cannot be written
删掉它；要做语言包的话，把 class 改成 \"lang\"。: Delete it; to create a language pack, change class to "lang".
权限写得不对：「{where}」不认识，或者 {class} 插件不能有: The permissions are written incorrectly: "{where}" is not recognized, or the {class} plug-in cannot be included.
外观插件能用的权限：assets.override（替换本安装已有的素材）、as: Permissions that can be used by appearance plug-ins: assets.override (replacing existing assets in this installation), assets.add (adding an entry that is not in this installation), and theme; interface plug-ins use ui.frame. "permissions" should be written as a list.
「{where}」需要权限 {need}，清单里没有声明: "{where}" requires permission {need}, which is not declared in the list.
声明了权限 {permission}，但插件里没有用到它的东西: The permission {permission} is declared, but nothing in the plug-in uses it.
从 \"permissions\" 里删掉 \"{permission}\"（声: Delete "{permission}" from "permissions" (the fewer permissions declared, the more reassuring).
外观插件要在 \"assets\" 里写要替换的素材。在工作台用模板开始最省事。: The appearance plug-in must write the assets to be replaced in "assets". It's easiest to start with a template on your workbench.
{where} 是符号链接（快捷方式），插件里只能放普通文件: {where} is a symbolic link (shortcut), and only ordinary files can be placed in the plug-in.

一份 offers/*.json 是 { \"offer\": 1, \"id\: An offer/*.json is { "offer": 1, "id": "window name", "when": { "at": ["battleCheck" or "prep"], "rounds": rounds }, "windowSec": seconds, "slots": 1–6, "options": { "source": "JSON file in the plugin" } }; windowSec defaults to 0 (no window opening, no blocking).

\"pluginId\" 写装着这份规格的插件自己的 id（插件文件夹名），或者: "pluginId" Write the id (plugin folder name) of the plug-in that contains this specification, or leave it blank and let the server fill it in. A plugin cannot use the action budget of another plugin.
动作预算 \"budget\" 要是 1 到 10000000 的整数: Action budget "budget" should be an integer from 1 to 10000000
写一个整数，或者删掉 \"budget\" 用默认的 8000。一场战斗里这个插: Write an integer, or delete "budget" and use the default of 8000. The number of actions performed by this plug-in in a battle exceeds the budget, and its effect stops in this battle.
DSL 里写了循环或外部代码，或者嵌套太深：{detail}: Loops or external code are written in the DSL, or are nested too deeply: {detail}
DSL 不支持循环和代码（loop、while、script 之类的字段）；\": DSL does not support loops and codes (fields such as loop, while, script); "then" can be nested up to 4 levels, and one value can have up to 64 levels and 64 nodes. Complex logic is made into script plug-ins.
战斗里用 always、deploy、battleStart、attack、hi: Use always, deploy, battleStart, attack, hitDealt, hitTaken, kill, allyDeath, skillStart, skillEnd, every, hpBelow in battle; use roundStart, income, buy, sell, refresh, merge, levelUp, battleResult in preparation.
条件写成 { \"条件名\": 值 }，条件名用 chance、targetHa: The condition is written as { "condition": value }, and the condition names are chance, targetHas, selfHpBelow, enemiesInRange, bondActive, and skillActive; only round, chance, and bondActive can be used for preparation.
\"do\" 是动作的列表，每个动作是 buff、status、damage、h: "do" is a list of actions. Each action is one of buff, status, damage, heal, sp, dp, push, pull, spawnToken, layers, shield, and fx (preparation is funds, layers, gainItem). See docs/PLUGIN-DSL.md §4 for their respective fields.
目标用 self、target、source、alliesInRange、ene: The target uses self, target, source, alliesInRange, enemiesInRange, enemiesInRadius, lowestHpAlly, allAllies; the "tile" of spawnToken writes "around" or { "r": row, "c": column }.
\"every\" 的间隔太短（{where}）：{detail}: The interval between "every" is too short ({where}): {detail}
\"seconds\" 至少是一帧（1/30 秒）。: "seconds" is at least one frame (1/30th of a second).
数值不在允许的范围里（{where}）：{detail}: The value is not within the allowed range ({where}): {detail}
写有限的数：hpBelow 的阈值大于 0、不超过 1，\"times\" 是: Write finite numbers: hpBelow's threshold is greater than 0 and not greater than 1, and "times" is an integer from 1 to 8.
\"div\" 的第二项不能是 0；要表示「不变」就乘以 1。: The second term of "div" cannot be 0; to mean "unchanged" multiply by 1.
取值是数字、{ \"bb\": \"键\" }、{ \"talent\": [序: The value is a number, { "bb": "key" }, { "talent": [index, "key"] }, or a combination using mul, add, sub, div, min, max; the list can only be written in these combinations.
技能规格写得不对（{where}）：{detail}: The skill specifications are written incorrectly ({where}): {detail}
\"skill\" 是一个对象，\"kind\" 用 instant、durat: "Skill" is an object, and "kind" uses instant, duration, ammo, charges, toggle, and passive; for several skills, just write "skills": { "Skill id": { … } }.
备战规格写得不对（{where}）：{detail}: The preparation specifications are written incorrectly ({where}): {detail}
写成 \"meta\": { \"on\": [ { \"when\": 触发器: Use "meta": { "on": [ { "when": trigger, "do": [ action ] } ] }. Set "meta.key" to effect:<plugin id>:<name>, using this plugin's own id.
\"talents\" 是列表，每一项是 { \"when\": 触发器, \": "talents" is a list, each item is an object like { "when": trigger, "if": condition, "do": [ action ] }.
目录文件的结构不对：{detail}: The directory file structure is incorrect: {detail}
目录是一个 JSON 对象，\"catalog\" 为 1，\"name\" 是: The catalog is a JSON object, "catalog" is 1, "name" is the name, and "plugins" is the list of plugins.
目录或插件地址不是可以下载的 https：{detail}: The directory or plug-in address is not downloadable https: {detail}
地址以 https:// 开头，主机名要有点，不能写账号密码。下载时只访问公网地: The address starts with https://, the host name must have a dot, and the account password cannot be written. When downloading, only port 443 of the public network address is accessed; intranet, local machine, link local and .local will be rejected unless the server owner names them in allowDownloadHosts.
目录条目缺少 sha256，或者不是 64 位小写十六进制：{detail}: Directory entry is missing sha256 or is not 64-bit lowercase hex: {detail}
每个插件都写上它的 zip 的 SHA-256（64 位小写十六进制）。: Each plugin writes the SHA-256 (64-bit lowercase hexadecimal) of its zip.
插件 id 不合法或重复：{detail}: The plug-in id is invalid or duplicate: {detail}
id 是 2 到 32 位小写字母、数字和连字符，并且在这份目录里只出现一次。: The id is 2 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and appears only once in this directory.
按 docs/plugin-catalog.example.json 写：版本是: Write as docs/plugin-catalog.example.json: The version is semver, class is a known category, and text that is too long should be shortened.
目录本身不超过 1 MB。插件 zip 另有 200 MB 的上限。: The directory itself is no larger than 1 MB. There is an additional 200 MB limit for plugin zips.
确认地址是公网 https 的 443 端口、服务器能访问它，并且没有被重定向到: Confirm that the address is port 443 of public https, that the server can access it, and that it is not redirected to the intranet or non-https. This time the wait contains the text, rather than retiming every hop. You can also use the local directory file instead.
安装地址不是公网 https：{detail}: The installation address is not the public network https: {detail}
只安装公网 https、443 端口的 zip。内网和本机地址默认拒绝。本机文件: Only install public https and 443 port zip. Intranet and local machine addresses are rejected by default. Native files can be given paths directly, including Windows drive letters and UNC.
zip 的 SHA-256 对不上，或者没有给出：{detail}: The SHA-256 of zip does not match, or is not given: {detail}
https 安装必须带 --sha256（或目录条目里的 sha256）。哈希不: https installations must have --sha256 (or sha256 in the directory entry). If the hash is incorrect, do not install it.
zip 超过大小上限，或和目录里写的字节数不一致：{detail}: The zip size exceeds the upper limit or is inconsistent with the number of bytes written in the directory: {detail}
一个插件不超过 200 MB。目录里的 bytes 要和 zip 的实际大小一致: A plug-in cannot exceed 200 MB. The bytes in the directory must be consistent with the actual size of the zip.
检查网络后重试。zip 最长等 60 秒，目录最长等 20 秒。这一次等待包含连: Check the network and try again. Wait up to 60 seconds for zip and 20 seconds for directories. This time the wait includes connection, redirection and body, rather than retiming for each hop.
确认地址能打开，并且返回的是 zip（HTTP 200）。: Confirm that the address can be opened and that a zip is returned (HTTP 200).
下载被重定向到了非公网地址、非 443 端口，或重定向次数太多：{detail}: The download was redirected to a non-public address, non-443 port, or too many redirects: {detail}
只跟随公网 https、443 端口的重定向，最多 5 次。请换一个直接的 ht: Only follow public network https and 443 port redirects, up to 5 times. Please change to a direct https address.
zip 里要有 plugin.json（可以包在一层以插件 id 命名的文件夹里: There must be plugin.json in the zip (it can be packaged in a folder named after the plugin ID). There cannot be path traversals, symbolic links, encrypted or oversized files.

plugins/ 里已经有这个 id：{detail}: There is already this id in plugins/: {detail}
